title.zh: 卷18 本紀十八 宣宗本紀二
title.raw: 卷18 本紀十八 宣宗本紀二

sentences.zh: 十一年春正月辛酉，紮隆阿免，以哈哴阿、楊芳護理喀什噶爾參贊大臣。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, spring, first month, day xinyou, Zhalong'a was dismissed; Har'a and Yang Fang were ordered to administer the Kashgar resident minister post.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 11, month 1, xinyou, Zhalong'a left office; Har'a and Yang Fang took charge at Kashgar.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，容安論斬。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Rong'an was sentenced to execution.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Rong'an was condemned to death.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以魏元烺為福建巡撫。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Wei Yuanhuang was made Fujian governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Wei Yuanhuang became Fujian governor.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮國王李鍚請封其孫奐為世孫，貢方物。

translations.literal: The King of Korea, Li Xi, asked to enfeoff his grandson Huan as heir-apparent grandson and presented tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: Korea's King Li Xi asked to enfeoff grandson Huan as heir-apparent grandson and sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 是月，給江蘇沛縣、安徽蕪湖等八州縣衛、浙江富陽縣被災口糧。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was given to eight districts and guards including Pei in Jiangsu, Wuhu in Anhui, and Fuyang in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: That month eight disaster districts including Pei, Wuhu, and Fuyang received ration grain.

sentences.zh: 貸三姓、雙城堡兵民，直隸磁州等九州縣，湖南安鄉、華容二縣，河南武安縣，甘肅會寧等五縣被災口糧、屋費、籽種。

translations.literal: Ration grain, house-repair funds, and seed were lent to troops and people at Sanxing and Shuangcheng Bao, nine Zhili districts including Cizhou, Anxiang and Huarong in Hunan, Wu'an in Henan, and five Gansu counties including Huining.
translations.idiomatic: Disaster loans of grain, repair funds, and seed went to Sanxing, Shuangcheng Bao, nine Zhili districts, two Hunan counties, Wu'an, and five Gansu counties.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩吉林等四處兵民新舊額賦。

translations.literal: Old and new quota taxes were remitted or deferred for troops and people in four places including Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: Jilin and three other districts had old and new taxes remitted or deferred.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑，御經筵。

translations.literal: Second month, day jichou: the Emperor attended the classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, jichou, the Emperor attended the classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以謁西陵，命奕紹等留京辦事。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, because of the visit to the Western Tombs, Yishao and others were ordered to remain in Beijing to conduct affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, for the Western Tombs visit, Yishao and others stayed in Beijing to govern.

sentences.zh: 那彥成以驅逐安集延回民啟釁，褫太子太保，並褫其子容照侍郎。

translations.literal: Nayancheng was stripped of Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent for provoking conflict by expelling Andijan Hui Muslims, and his son Rongzhao was also stripped of vice minister rank.
translations.idiomatic: Nayancheng lost Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent for expelling Andijan Muslims and provoking trouble; son Rongzhao lost vice minister rank.

sentences.zh: 乙未，褫那彥成職，調琦善為直隸總督，王鼎署。

translations.literal: On day weimo, Nayancheng was dismissed from office; Qishan was transferred as Zhili governor-general, with Wang Ding acting.
translations.idiomatic: On weimo Nayancheng was dismissed; Qishan became Zhili governor-general with Wang Ding acting.

sentences.zh: 以鄂山為四川總督，那彥寶署，史譜為陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: Eshan was made Sichuan governor-general, with Nayanchengbao acting; Shi Pu was made Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Eshan took Sichuan with Nayanchengbao acting; Shi Pu took Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，申禁各省種鬻鴉片。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, the ban on cultivating and selling opium in all provinces was reiterated.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu all provinces were again forbidden to grow or sell opium.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，上謁西陵。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the Emperor visited the Western Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the Emperor visited the Western Tombs.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，謁泰陵、泰東陵、昌陵。

translations.literal: On day yisi, he visited Tailing, Taidongling, and Changling.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he visited Tailing, Taidongling, and Changling.

sentences.zh: 上閱視萬年吉地，賜名龍泉峪。

translations.literal: The Emperor inspected the eternal auspicious site and bestowed the name Longquan Yu.
translations.idiomatic: He inspected the eternal tomb site and named it Longquan Yu.

sentences.zh: 丙午，上再謁昌陵，行敷土禮。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the Emperor again visited Changling and performed the earth-spreading rite.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he again visited Changling and performed the earth-spreading rite.

sentences.zh: 御隆恩殿行大饗禮。

translations.literal: At Long'en Hall he held the great feast rite.
translations.idiomatic: At Long'en Hall he held the great feast rite.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸湖北荊門營上年被水兵丁倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, grain stores were lent to Jingmen garrison troops flooded the previous year.
translations.idiomatic: That month Jingmen garrison troops flooded the year before received lent grain stores.

sentences.zh: 三月癸丑朔，釋英和並其子奎照、奎耀回京。

translations.literal: Third month, new moon on day guichou: Yinghe and his sons Kuizhao and Kuiyao were released to return to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, guichou new moon, Yinghe and sons Kuizhao and Kuiyao were freed to return to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 廣東黎匪作亂，命李鴻賓剿之。

translations.literal: Li bandits rebelled in Guangdong; Li Hongbin was ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Li rebels rose in Guangdong; Li Hongbin was sent to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以廣東貿易英吉利人違禁令，命李鴻賓等查覆。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, because British traders in Guangdong trade violated the ban, Li Hongbin and others were ordered to investigate and report.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou British traders in Guangdong broke the ban; Li Hongbin and others were ordered to investigate.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸湖北督標、撫標暨武昌、黃州各營兵丁倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, grain stores were lent to the Hubei governor-general and governor banners and to garrisons at Wuchang and Huangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month Hubei governor and governor banners and Wuchang and Huangzhou garrisons received lent grain stores.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊子，上閱健銳營兵。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day wuzi: the Emperor reviewed Jianrui Camp troops.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, month 4, wuzi, the Emperor reviewed Jianrui Camp troops.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上詣黑龍潭神祠祈雨。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Emperor prayed for rain at the Black Dragon Pool shrine.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the Emperor prayed for rain at the Black Dragon Pool shrine.

sentences.zh: 廣東黎匪平。

translations.literal: The Guangdong Li bandits were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong Li bandits were pacified.

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅，湯金釗緣事降，並罷上書房總師傅。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingyin: Tang Jinzhao was demoted over an affair and also removed as chief tutor of the Upper Study.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, bingyin, Tang Jinzhao was demoted and lost his Upper Study chief tutorship.

sentences.zh: 調潘世恩為吏部尚書，朱士彥工部尚書，白鎔都察院左都御史。

translations.literal: Pan Shien was transferred to Minister of Personnel; Zhu Shiyan to Works; Bai Rong to Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Shien took personnel; Zhu Shiyan works; Bai Rong the left censorate.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，命長齡赴喀什噶爾商辦剿撫及善後事宜。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Changling was ordered to Kashgar to discuss suppression, pacification, and follow-up affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Changling was sent to Kashgar to handle suppression, pacification, and aftermath.

sentences.zh: 辛未，雨。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei it rained.

sentences.zh: 六月丙申，申定官民買食鴉片煙罪例。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingshen: penalties for officials and commoners buying and consuming opium were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, bingshen, penalties for officials and commoners buying and smoking opium were fixed.

sentences.zh: 己亥，賑安徽泗州等二十五州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day jihai, flood disaster relief was given to twenty-five Anhui districts including Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai twenty-five Anhui districts including Sizhou received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以湖北沔陽等二十州縣水災，命平糶倉穀，免湖北關津米稅。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, because twenty Hubei districts including Mianyang suffered flood, grain stores were ordered sold at fair price and Hubei transit rice taxes were waived.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu twenty flooded Hubei districts including Mianyang had fair-price grain sales and transit rice taxes waived.

sentences.zh: 是月，給江蘇上元等九縣衛水災口糧。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was given to nine Jiangsu districts and guards including Shangyuan for flood.
translations.idiomatic: That month nine flooded Jiangsu districts including Shangyuan received ration grain.

sentences.zh: 貸江蘇淮安衛災屯籽種。

translations.literal: Seed grain was lent to flood-stricken tun settlements of Huai'anwei in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Flood-hit Huai'anwei tun settlements in Jiangsu received lent seed grain.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊午，命陶澍偕程祖洛辦江蘇災賑。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuwu: Tao Shu with Cheng Zuluo were ordered to handle Jiangsu disaster relief.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, month 7, wuwu, Tao Shu and Cheng Zuluo were ordered to handle Jiangsu disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 以安徽水災，准鄧廷楨買鄰省米麥平糶，並備兵糈。

translations.literal: Because of Anhui floods, Deng Tingzhen was allowed to buy grain from neighboring provinces for fair sale and to prepare army rations.
translations.idiomatic: For Anhui floods Deng Tingzhen could buy neighboring grain for fair sale and army rations.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以誣陷回王伊薩克叛逆，紮隆阿論斬。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Zhalong'a was sentenced to execution for falsely implicating the Muslim king Isa in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Zhalong'a was condemned for falsely charging Muslim king Isa with rebellion.

sentences.zh: 辛未，移回疆參贊大臣及和闐領隊大臣駐葉爾羌，添設總兵駐巴爾楚克。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, the Xinjiang resident minister and Hotan brigade commander posts were moved to Yarkand, and a regional commander was added at Barkul.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the Xinjiang resident minister and Hotan brigade commander moved to Yarkand; a commander was added at Barkul.

sentences.zh: 己卯，命穆彰阿、朱士彥往江南查辦賑務。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Muzhang'a and Zhu Shiyan were ordered to Jiangnan to investigate relief affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Muzhang'a and Zhu Shiyan were sent to Jiangnan to investigate relief.

sentences.zh: 是月，給湖南武陵等五州縣，貴州桐梓縣、石峴衛水災口糧。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was given to five Hunan districts including Wuling, Tongzi in Guizhou, and Shixian guard.
translations.idiomatic: That month Wuling and four other Hunan districts, Tongzi, and Shixian guard received ration grain.

sentences.zh: 貸江蘇江甯等六營災區兵餉。

translations.literal: Pay was lent to six Jiangsu garrisons including Jiangning in disaster areas.
translations.idiomatic: Six Jiangsu garrisons including Jiangning received lent disaster pay.

sentences.zh: 八月己丑，萬壽節，上詣皇太后宮行禮。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jichou, longevity festival: the Emperor went to the Empress Dowager's palace to perform rites.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, jichou, longevity day, the Emperor paid respects at the Empress Dowager's palace.

sentences.zh: 御正大光明殿，王以下文武各官，蒙古王公、外籓使臣等行慶賀禮，停筵宴。

translations.literal: At the Hall of Supreme Harmony, princes and civil and military officials, Mongol nobles, and foreign envoys performed congratulations; the banquet was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: At the Hall of Supreme Harmony princes, officials, Mongol nobles, and foreign envoys congratulated; no banquet was held.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，晉長齡太傅。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Changling was advanced to Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Changling became Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 乙未，松筠病免，調穆彰阿兵部尚書，富俊工部尚書。

translations.literal: On day weimo, Songyun was dismissed for illness; Muzhang'a was transferred to Minister of War; Fujun to Works.
translations.idiomatic: On weimo Songyun left for illness; Muzhang'a took war and Fujun works.

sentences.zh: 以博啟圖為理籓院尚書。

translations.literal: Boqitu was made Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Boqitu took the Colonial Affairs ministry.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，暹羅國王遣貢使載內地遭風官民回廣東，溫諭獎賚之。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the King of Siam sent a tribute envoy returning officials and people from the interior stranded by wind to Guangdong; a warm edict praised and rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Siam's envoy returned storm-stranded interior subjects to Guangdong and received warm praise and reward.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以保昌為熱河都統。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Baochang was made Rehe commander.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Baochang became Rehe commander.

sentences.zh: 以吳榮光為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: Wu Rongguang was made Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Rongguang became Hunan governor.

sentences.zh: 是月，給江蘇甘泉等十一州縣、湖北江夏等十六州縣、江西德化等二十縣水災口糧籽種。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain and seed were given for floods to eleven Jiangsu districts including Ganquan, sixteen Hubei including Jiangxia, and twenty Jiangxi including Dehua.
translations.idiomatic: That month eleven Jiangsu, sixteen Hubei, and twenty Jiangxi flood districts received ration grain and seed.

sentences.zh: 貸江南江寧駐防及溧陽營兵米。

translations.literal: Rice was lent to the Jiangning garrison and Liyang Camp in Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangnan's Jiangning garrison and Liyang Camp received lent rice.

sentences.zh: 九月甲子，福克精阿緣事褫職，以寶興為吉林將軍。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiazi: Fukejing'a was stripped of office over an affair; Baoxing was made Jilin general.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, jiazi, Fukejing'a lost office over an affair; Baoxing became Jilin general.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，越南國王遣使送遭風難民回福建，溫諭獎賚之。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the King of Vietnam sent an envoy returning storm victims to Fujian; a warm edict praised and rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Vietnam's envoy returned storm victims to Fujian and received warm praise and reward.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，嚴烺病免，以林則徐為河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month: Yan Yan was dismissed for illness; Lin Zexu was made Hedong river conservancy governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, month 10, Yan Yan left for illness; Lin Zexu became Hedong river conservancy governor-general.

sentences.zh: 己丑，改喀什噶爾幫辦大臣為領隊大臣。

translations.literal: On day jichou, the Kashgar assistant post was changed to brigade commander.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Kashgar's assistant post became brigade commander.

sentences.zh: 乙未，命截留江西漕米八萬石賑南昌、九江饑民。

translations.literal: On day weimo, eighty thousand shi of Jiangxi tribute grain were ordered retained to relieve famine in Nanchang and Jiujiang.
translations.idiomatic: On weimo eighty thousand shi of Jiangxi tribute grain were held back for Nanchang and Jiujiang famine relief.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑安徽無為等二十三州縣衛、江蘇上元等二十六州縣、浙江仁和等七縣衛、兩淮丁谿等六場水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood relief was given to twenty-three Anhui districts and guards including Wuwei, twenty-six Jiangsu including Shangyuan, seven Zhejiang including Renhe, and six Lianghuai salt fields including Dingxi.
translations.idiomatic: That month floods were relieved in twenty-three Anhui, twenty-six Jiangsu, seven Zhejiang, and six Lianghuai salt districts.

sentences.zh: 給安徽桐城等十州縣，湖南武陵等五縣，江西德化縣口糧、修屋費。

translations.literal: Ration grain and house-repair funds were given to ten Anhui districts including Tongcheng, five Hunan including Wuling, and Dehua in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Tongcheng and nine other Anhui districts, five Hunan counties, and Dehua received ration grain and repair funds.

sentences.zh: 貸甘肅皋蘭等十八州廳縣口糧，湖南武陵、龍陽二縣民堤修費。

translations.literal: Ration grain was lent in eighteen Gansu districts including Gaolan; dyke repair funds were lent for Wuling and Longyang in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: Eighteen Gansu districts including Gaolan received lent grain; Wuling and Longyang received dyke repair funds.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙辰，大學士托津病免。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingchen: Grand Secretary Tuojin was dismissed for illness.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, bingchen, Grand Secretary Tuojin left for illness.

sentences.zh: 授吳邦慶漕運總督。

translations.literal: Wu Bangqing was made grain transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Bangqing became grain transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 己巳，松筠罷內大臣，降三品頂戴休致。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Songyun was removed as inner grand minister, demoted to third-rank top, and retired.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Songyun lost inner grand minister rank, took third-rank top, and retired.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸奉天鐵嶺等五州廳及巨流河四處口糧，江西南昌等六縣修堤費。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was lent at five Fengtian districts including Tieling and four Juliu River places; dyke funds were lent for six Jiangxi counties including Nanchang.
translations.idiomatic: That month Tieling and four other Fengtian districts and four Juliu River places received lent grain; six Jiangxi counties including Nanchang received dyke funds.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩甯古塔、雙城堡雹災霜災新舊額賦。

translations.literal: Old and new quota taxes were remitted or deferred for hail and frost at Ningguta and Shuangcheng Bao.
translations.idiomatic: Ningguta and Shuangcheng Bao had hail and frost taxes remitted or deferred.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙酉，以富俊為大學士，管兵部，文孚協辦大學士。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day yiyou: Fujun was made grand secretary in charge of War; Wen Fu was made associate grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, yiyou, Fujun became grand secretary over War; Wen Fu became associate grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 調穆彰阿為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Muzhang'a was transferred to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Muzhang'a took works.

sentences.zh: 以那清安為兵部尚書，升寅為都察院左都御史，彥德為綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: Na Qing'an was made Minister of War; Sheng Yin was made Left Censor-in-Chief; Yande was made Suiyuan City general.
translations.idiomatic: Na Qing'an took war; Sheng Yin the left censorate; Yande became Suiyuan City general.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以吳邦慶為江西巡撫，蘇成額為漕運總督。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Wu Bangqing was made Jiangxi governor; Su Chenge was made grain transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Wu Bangqing took Jiangxi and Su Chenge grain transport.

sentences.zh: 是月，展賑湖北江夏等十六州縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, extended relief was given for floods in sixteen Hubei districts including Jiangxia.
translations.idiomatic: That month sixteen flooded Hubei districts including Jiangxia received extended relief.

sentences.zh: 給江蘇上元等二十五州縣衛及丁谿十五場水災口糧。

translations.literal: Ration grain was given for floods to twenty-five Jiangsu districts and guards including Shangyuan and fifteen Dingxi salt fields.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-five Jiangsu districts including Shangyuan and fifteen Dingxi salt fields received flood ration grain.

sentences.zh: 貸江蘇鎮江等二十七營，湖南常德、澧州各營水災兵餉。

translations.literal: Pay was lent to twenty-seven Jiangsu garrisons including Zhenjiang and to Changde and Lizhou camps in Hunan for flood.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-seven Jiangsu garrisons including Zhenjiang and Changde and Lizhou camps received lent flood pay.

sentences.zh: 十二年春正月辛酉，免浙江杭州等三府商船米稅。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, spring, first month, day xinyou, commercial ship rice tax was waived for three Zhejiang prefectures including Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 12, month 1, xinyou, commercial ship rice tax was waived for Hangzhou and two other Zhejiang prefectures.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，陳若霖免，以戴敦元署刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Chen Ruolin was dismissed; Dai Dunyuan was ordered to act as Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Chen Ruolin left office; Dai Dunyuan acted at Punishments.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，王引之丁憂，以汪守和為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Wang Yinzhi entered mourning leave; Wang Shouhe was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Wang Yinzhi mourned; Wang Shouhe took rites.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑安徽懷寧等二十一州縣水災旱災，並給懷寧等十七縣衛貧民口糧。

translations.literal: That month, flood and drought relief was given to twenty-one Anhui districts including Huaining, and poor relief grain was given to seventeen districts and guards including Huaining.
translations.idiomatic: That month twenty-one Anhui districts including Huaining were relieved for flood and drought; seventeen including Huaining received poor relief grain.

sentences.zh: 貸直隸大名等四州縣、河南商丘等三縣災民米穀，陝西葭州等四州縣、江西南昌等十六縣、湖北江夏等二十州縣衛、湖南武陵等十州廳縣衛、甘肅渭源等七州縣、貴州桐梓縣災民口糧籽種。

translations.literal: Grain was lent to disaster victims in four Zhili districts including Daming, three Henan including Shangqiu, four Shaanxi including Jiazhou, sixteen Jiangxi including Nanchang, twenty Hubei districts and guards including Jiangxia, ten Hunan districts and guards including Wuling, seven Gansu including Weiyuan, and Tongzi in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Disaster grain and seed loans went to victims in Zhili, Henan, Shaanxi, Jiangxi, Hubei, Hunan, Gansu, and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 二月戊寅，湖南江華縣瑤賊趙金龍作亂，命盧坤等剿之。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuyin: Yao bandit Zhao Jinlong rebelled in Jianghua, Hunan; Lu Kun and others were ordered to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, wuyin, Yao rebel Zhao Jinlong rose in Jianghua; Lu Kun and others were sent to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 己卯，御經筵。

translations.literal: On day jimao, the Emperor attended the classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the Emperor attended the classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 甲申，梁中靖奏查辦邪教株連冤抑，諭斥之。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Liang Zhongjing memorialized on investigating heterodox sects with wrongful implication and suppression; an edict rebuked him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Liang Zhongjing attacked wrongful sect prosecutions and was rebuked by edict.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，鍾昌降調。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Zhong Chang was demoted and transferred.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Zhong Chang was demoted and transferred.

sentences.zh: 授戴敦元刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Dai Dunyuan was made Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Dunyuan took Punishments.

sentences.zh: 乙未，閩浙總督孫爾准卒，以程祖洛為閩浙總督，林則徐為江蘇巡撫，吳邦慶為河東河道總督，周之琦為江西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day weimo, Fujian-Zhejiang Governor-General Sun Erzhun died; Cheng Zuluo was made Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general, Lin Zexu Jiangsu governor, Wu Bangqing Hedong river conservancy governor-general, and Zhou Zhiqi Jiangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On weimo Sun Erzhun died; Cheng Zuluo took Fujian-Zhejiang, Lin Zexu Jiangsu, Wu Bangqing Hedong river works, Zhou Zhiqi Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 丙申，命李鴻賓剿瑤賊。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Li Hongbin was ordered to suppress the Yao bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Li Hongbin was sent to suppress the Yao bandits.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以謁東陵，命奕紹等留京辦事。

translations.literal: On day renyin, because of the visit to the Eastern Tombs, Yishao and others were ordered to remain in Beijing to conduct affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, for the Eastern Tombs visit, Yishao and others stayed in Beijing to govern.

sentences.zh: 三月己酉，湖南提督海陵阿、副將馬韜等剿瑤賊于寧遠，失利，死之。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiyou: Hunan Commander Hailing'a, Vice General Ma Tao, and others fought Yao bandits at Ningyuan, were defeated, and died.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, jiyou, Hailing'a and Ma Tao fought Yao bandits at Ningyuan, lost, and were killed.

sentences.zh: 壬子，上謁東陵，免經過地方額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs and waived thirty percent of quota taxes along the route.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs and cut route taxes by thirty percent.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，上謁昭西陵、孝陵、孝東陵、景陵、裕陵。

translations.literal: On day yimao, the Emperor visited Zhaoxiling, Xiaoling, Xiaodongling, Jingling, and Yuling.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao he visited Zhaoxiling, Xiaoling, Xiaodongling, Jingling, and Yuling.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，召瑚松額，以奕顥署盛京將軍。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Husong'e was summoned; Yihao was ordered to act as Shengjing general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Husong'e was summoned; Yihao acted as Shengjing general.

sentences.zh: 己未，上幸南苑行圍。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, the Emperor went to the Southern Park for the encircling hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the Emperor hunted at the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 庚申，召長齡。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, Changling was summoned.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Changling was summoned.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day guihai, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 庚午，命戶部尚書禧恩赴湖南剿瑤賊，以文孚署戶部尚書。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Minister of Revenue Xi'en was ordered to Hunan to suppress Yao bandits; Wen Fu was ordered to act as Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Xi'en was sent to Hunan against the Yao bandits; Wen Fu acted at Revenue.

sentences.zh: 是月，展賑湖北江夏、漢川二縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, extended relief was given for floods in Jiangxia and Hanchuan in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: That month Jiangxia and Hanchuan received extended flood relief.

sentences.zh: 給安徽青陽縣災民口糧。

translations.literal: Ration grain was given to disaster victims in Qingyang, Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: Qingyang disaster victims received ration grain.

sentences.zh: 貸甘肅皋蘭等七州縣災民、湖南乾州等五州縣屯丁口糧籽種，湖北督標、提標及武昌城守營被災兵丁倉穀。

translations.literal: Ration grain and seed were lent to disaster victims in seven Gansu districts including Gaolan and to tun settlers in five Hunan districts including Qianzhou; grain stores were lent to flooded troops of the Hubei governor-general and provincial commander banners and the Wuchang city garrison.
translations.idiomatic: Gaolan and six other Gansu districts, five Qianzhou-area Hunan tun districts, and flooded Hubei banners and Wuchang garrison received disaster loans.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸巳，祈雨。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guisi: prayers for rain.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, month 4, guisi, the court prayed for rain.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，雨。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu it rained.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，賜吳鍾駿等二百六人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, two hundred six men including Wu Zhongjun were granted metropolitan graduate degrees with rank differences.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou 206 men including Wu Zhongjun received jinshi degrees with differing ranks.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，盧坤等敗瑤賊於羊泉，盡殲之，獲趙金龍子及賊首五十餘人。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Lu Kun and others defeated Yao bandits at Yangquan, annihilated them, and captured Zhao Jinlong's son and more than fifty bandit chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Lu Kun routed Yao bandits at Yangquan, killed them all, and took Zhao Jinlong's son and over fifty chiefs.

sentences.zh: 是月，再給江蘇揚州水災倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, granary grain was again issued for the Jiangsu Yangzhou flood disaster.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yangzhou flood victims in Jiangsu received more granary grain.

sentences.zh: 五月丁未，減福建水陸各營及浙江馬步兵有差。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingwei: Fujian land and naval camps and Zhejiang cavalry and infantry were reduced by varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, dingwei, Fujian and Zhejiang troop strengths were cut by degrees.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以趙金龍已斃，餘賊悉平，賞盧坤、羅思舉雙眼花翎、一等輕車都尉世職，加湖南提督余步雲太子少保。

translations.literal: On day renzi, because Zhao Jinlong was already killed and the remaining bandits were all pacified, Lu Kun and Luo Siju were awarded double peacock feathers and hereditary first-class Commandant of Light Chariots, and Hunan Provincial Military Commander Yu Buyun was advanced to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, with Zhao Jinlong dead and rebels pacified, Lu Kun and Luo Siju won peacock plumes and hereditary ranks, and Yu Buyun became Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，教匪尹老須等伏誅。

translations.literal: On day yimao, the teaching-bandit Yin Laoxu and others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Yin Laoxu and other sect rebels were executed.

sentences.zh: 庚申，上祈雨於黑龍潭。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, the Emperor prayed for rain at the Black Dragon Pool shrine.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the Emperor prayed for rain at the Black Dragon Pool shrine.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，上詣天神壇祈雨。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the Emperor went to the Altar of the Heavenly Spirit to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the Emperor prayed for rain at the Heavenly Spirit Altar.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔刑部清釐庶獄。

translations.literal: On day jisi, an edict ordered the Ministry of Punishments to clear ordinary prison cases.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi punishments was ordered to clear routine prison cases.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸山西大同等三縣被災兵民倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, granary grain was lent to soldiers and civilians suffering disaster in three Shanxi counties including Datong.
translations.idiomatic: That month Datong and two other Shanxi counties received lent granary grain after disaster.

sentences.zh: 六月庚辰，上步詣社稷壇祈雨。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengchen: the Emperor walked to the Altar of Soil and Grain to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, gengchen, the Emperor walked to the Soil and Grain Altar for rain prayers.

sentences.zh: 壬午，求直言。

translations.literal: On day renwu, frank counsel was sought.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the court sought frank counsel.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, the Emperor went to the Black Dragon Pool shrine to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the Emperor again prayed for rain at the Black Dragon Pool shrine.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以廣東提督劉榮慶剿連州瑤賊失利，褫職，李鴻賓褫職留任。

translations.literal: On day renchen, because Guangdong Provincial Military Commander Liu Rongqing failed in suppressing the Lianzhou Yao bandits, he was stripped of office; Li Hongbin was stripped but retained in post.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Liu Rongqing lost his post over a failed Yao campaign at Lianzhou; Li Hongbin was demoted but kept on duty.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，上步詣方澤祈雨。

translations.literal: On day guisi, the Emperor walked to the Square Mound to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the Emperor walked to the Square Mound for rain prayers.

sentences.zh: 乙未，富俊以旱乞罷。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Fujun begged to resign because of drought.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Fujun asked to resign citing drought.

sentences.zh: 不允。

translations.literal: The request was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was denied.

sentences.zh: 丙申，霍罕遣使進表，歸所擄喀什噶爾回民。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Kokand sent envoys with a memorial, returning captured Kashgar Hui Muslims.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Kokand sent envoys and returned captured Kashgar Muslims.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，復松筠頭品頂戴。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Songyun's first-rank hat ornament was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Songyun regained his first-rank hat ornament.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上自齋宮步詣圜丘行大雩禮。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Emperor walked from the fasting palace to the Circular Mound to perform the major rain ritual.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the Emperor walked from the fasting palace to the Circular Mound for the great rain ritual.

sentences.zh: 是日，雨。

translations.literal: That day it rained.
translations.idiomatic: Rain fell that day.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，命禧恩、瑚松額自湖南赴廣東剿瑤賊。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Xi'en and Husong'e were ordered from Hunan to Guangdong to suppress Yao bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Xi'en and Husong'e were sent from Hunan to Guangdong against the Yao.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸江蘇淮安衛水災屯田籽種。

translations.literal: That month, seed grain was lent to flood-stricken tun settlements of Huai'anwei in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: That month flood-hit Huai'anwei tun settlements in Jiangsu received lent seed grain.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁未，宥容安，遣戍吉林。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dingwei: Rong'an was pardoned and banished to serve in Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, dingwei, Rong'an was pardoned and sent to exile in Jilin.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以鍾昌為科布多參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Zhong Chang was made Kobdo Military Deputy Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Zhong Chang became Kobdo deputy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 命程祖洛清理浙江鹽政。

translations.literal: Cheng Zuluo was ordered to clean up Zhejiang salt administration.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Zuluo was ordered to reform Zhejiang salt affairs.

sentences.zh: 和闐回塔瓦克等糾眾作亂，捕誅之。

translations.literal: Khotan Muslims Tawake and others gathered a crowd in rebellion; they were captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Tawake and other Khotan rebels were captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，廣西賀縣瑤盤均華等作亂，祁剿平之。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Pan Junhua and other Yao of Hexian in Guangxi rebelled; Qi suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Guangxi Yao rebels led by Pan Junhua were pacified by Qi.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑福建澎湖廳風災。

translations.literal: That month, Penghu subprefecture in Fujian was relieved after a wind disaster.
translations.idiomatic: That month Fujian's Penghu was relieved after a typhoon.

sentences.zh: 給湖北天門縣水災口糧。

translations.literal: Ration grain was issued for the flood disaster at Tianmen county, Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: Tianmen county in Hubei received ration grain for flood victims.

sentences.zh: 八月，陶澍奏英船再入內洋，或不遵約束，當嚴懲。

translations.literal: Eighth month: Tao Shu memorialized that English ships had again entered the inner seas and, if they would not obey restrictions, should be sternly punished.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8 Tao Shu reported British ships in inner waters again and urged stern punishment if they disobeyed.

sentences.zh: 諭以啟釁斥之。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked him for provoking conflict and dismissed the proposal.
translations.idiomatic: The court rebuked Tao Shu for provocation and rejected the idea.

sentences.zh: 甲午，李鴻賓褫職，並提督劉榮慶逮問。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Li Hongbin was stripped of office and Provincial Military Commander Liu Rongqing was also seized for interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Li Hongbin was dismissed and Liu Rongqing was arrested for inquiry.

sentences.zh: 調盧坤為兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Lu Kun was transferred to Governor-General of Guangdong and Guangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Kun became governor-general of the Two Guang.

sentences.zh: 命阮元協辦大學士，仍留雲貴總督任。

translations.literal: Ruan Yuan was made Associate Grand Secretary while remaining Yunnan-Guizhou Governor-General.
translations.idiomatic: Ruan Yuan became associate grand secretary and kept Yunnan-Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 以訥爾經額為湖廣總督，鍾祥為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: Na'erjing'e was made Huguang Governor-General and Zhong Xiang Shandong governor.
translations.idiomatic: Na'erjing'e took Huguang and Zhong Xiang took Shandong.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑山西朔州水災。

translations.literal: That month, Shuozhou in Shanxi was relieved after flood.
translations.idiomatic: That month Shuozhou in Shanxi was relieved after flooding.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩安徽懷寧等二十九州縣衛上年水災旱災額賦。

translations.literal: Quota taxes for last year's flood and drought disasters were remitted or deferred for twenty-nine Anhui prefectures, counties, and guards including Huaining.
translations.idiomatic: Last year's disaster taxes were remitted or deferred for twenty-nine places in Anhui including Huaining.

sentences.zh: 九月甲辰朔，以尹濟源為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: Ninth month, first day jiachen: Yin Jiyuan was made Shanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On the 1st of month 9, jiachen, Yin Jiyuan became Shanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 丙午，南河龍窩汛堤盜決，命穆彰阿會同陶澍查辦，張井褫職留任。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the Longwo flood-post dike on the Southern Yellow River was breached by thieves; Muzhang'a was ordered jointly with Tao Shu to investigate, and Zhang Jing was stripped but retained.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu thieves breached the Longwo dike; Muzhang'a and Tao Shu were to investigate, and Zhang Jing was demoted but kept.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以英吉利船闌入內洋，命沿海整飭水師。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, because English ships had forced into the inner seas, coastal naval forces were ordered rectified.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei English ships in inner waters led to orders to tighten coastal naval forces.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以特依順保為伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, Te Yishunbao was made Ili General.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Te Yishunbao became Ili general.

sentences.zh: 戊午，廣東連州瑤平。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, the Lianzhou Yao in Guangdong were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the Lianzhou Yao in Guangdong were pacified.

sentences.zh: 湖南瑤趙幅金等伏誅。

translations.literal: Zhao Fujin and other Yao in Hunan were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Fujin and other Hunan Yao leaders were executed.

sentences.zh: 是月，給江蘇桃源縣、湖北天門縣等七縣衛水災口糧。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was issued for flood disasters at seven counties and guards including Taoyuan in Jiangsu and Tianmen in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: That month seven counties and guards including Taoyuan and Tianmen received flood rations.

sentences.zh: 貸山西山陰縣歉收倉穀。

translations.literal: Granary grain was lent for crop failure at Shanyin county, Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Shanyin county in Shanxi received lent granary grain after a poor harvest.

sentences.zh: 閏九月丁亥，上簡閱健銳營兵。

translations.literal: Intercalary ninth month, day dinghai: the Emperor inspected the Jianrui Camp troops.
translations.idiomatic: In intercalary month 9, dinghai, the Emperor inspected Jianrui Camp troops.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以朝鮮國王李鍚卻英吉利貿易，下詔褒獎之。

translations.literal: On day renyin, because Korean King Li Xi rejected English trade, an edict praised and rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the court praised Korea's King Li Xi for refusing British trade.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑直隸阜平等十州縣災民。

translations.literal: That month, disaster victims in ten Zhili prefectures and counties including Fuping were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month ten Zhili prefectures and counties including Fuping were relieved.

sentences.zh: 貸河南祥符等七州縣、陝西興安府水災口糧。

translations.literal: Ration grain was lent for floods at seven Henan prefectures and counties including Xiangfu and Xing'an prefecture in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Flood victims in seven Henan places including Xiangfu and Xing'an in Shaanxi received lent rations.

sentences.zh: 貸齊齊哈爾等處被旱兵丁銀穀。

translations.literal: Silver and grain were lent to soldiers and garrison personnel suffering drought at Qiqihar and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Drought-hit troops at Qiqihar and elsewhere received lent silver and grain.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙巳，廣東曲江、乳源兩縣盜匪作亂，剿平之。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yisi: bandits rebelled in Qujiang and Ruyuan counties in Guangdong and were suppressed and pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10, yisi, bandits in Qujiang and Ruyuan in Guangdong were suppressed.

sentences.zh: 丙午，命朱士彥、敬徵往江南查辦事件。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Zhu Shiyan and Jingzheng were ordered to Jiangnan to investigate affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Zhu Shiyan and Jingzheng were sent to Jiangnan on investigation.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，命穆彰阿至湖北會同訥爾經額查辦事件。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Muzhang'a was ordered to Hubei jointly with Na'erjing'e to investigate affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Muzhang'a was sent to Hubei with Na'erjing'e to investigate.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑直隸吳橋、東光二縣，江蘇桃源等三州縣，湖北漢川等四縣衛，安徽五河縣，兩淮板浦等三場水災旱災。

translations.literal: That month, flood and drought relief was given to two Zhili counties including Wuqiao and Dongguang, three Jiangsu prefectures and counties including Taoyuan, four Hubei counties and guards including Hankou, Wuhe county in Anhui, and three Lianghuai salt fields including Banpu.
translations.idiomatic: That month flood and drought relief went to Wuqiao and Dongguang in Zhili, Taoyuan and others in Jiangsu, Hankou and others in Hubei, Wuhe in Anhui, and Banpu and other salt fields.

sentences.zh: 給江蘇海州等四州縣，安徽五河等十一縣衛，湖南安鄉、華容二縣，奉天錦州府屬旗民口糧。

translations.literal: Ration grain was issued to four Jiangsu prefectures and counties including Haizhou, eleven Anhui counties and guards including Wuhe, Anxiang and Huarong in Hunan, and banner people under Jizhou prefecture in Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: Haizhou and three other Jiangsu places, eleven Anhui places including Wuhe, two Hunan counties, and Fengtian banner people under Jizhou received rations.

sentences.zh: 貸山西大同鎮災區駐防倉穀。

translations.literal: Granary grain was lent to garrison troops in the Datong garrison disaster zone in Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Datong garrison troops in the disaster zone received lent granary grain.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩直隸吳橋等十七州縣，江蘇桃源等六十三州廳縣衛，安徽五河等三十九州縣衛，浙江海寧等二十二州縣衛、仁和場，兩淮富安等十四場，湖南安鄉等七州縣衛，山西隰州等六州縣，湖北漢川等二十六州縣衛水災旱災雹災新舊額賦。

translations.literal: Quota taxes old and new for flood, drought, and hail disasters were remitted or deferred for seventeen Zhili prefectures and counties including Wuqiao, sixty-three Jiangsu prefectures, subprefectures, counties, and guards including Taoyuan, thirty-nine Anhui places including Wuhe, twenty-two Zhejiang places including Haining and Renhe field, fourteen Lianghuai fields including Fu'an, seven Hunan places including Anxiang, six Shanxi places including Xizhou, and twenty-six Hubei places including Hankou.
translations.idiomatic: Disaster taxes were remitted or deferred across Zhili, Jiangsu, Anhui, Zhejiang, Lianghuai salt fields, Hunan, Shanxi, and Hubei in long lists of affected places.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊寅，命署福州將軍瑚松額為欽差大臣，都統哈哴阿為參贊大臣，赴臺灣剿匪。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuyin: Acting Fuzhou General Husong'e was made Imperial Commissioner and Colonel Har'a Deputy Commissioner and sent to Taiwan to suppress bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, wuyin, Husong'e became Imperial Commissioner for Taiwan with Har'a as deputy.

sentences.zh: 丙申，撥京倉米一萬石賑順天府武清等八州縣災民。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, ten thousand shi of Beijing granary rice were allocated to relieve disaster victims in eight Shuntian prefectures and counties including Wuqing.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen 10,000 shi of Beijing granary rice went to eight Shuntian counties including Wuqing.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，李鴻賓遣戍烏魯木齊，劉榮慶遣戍伊犁。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Li Hongbin was banished to Urumqi and Liu Rongqing to Ili.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Li Hongbin was exiled to Urumqi and Liu Rongqing to Ili.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸陝西漢中等五府州廳屬、甘肅宜禾縣被災口糧，吉林等七處籽種。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was lent for disasters to subordinates of five Shaanxi prefectures including Hanzhong and Yihe county in Gansu, and seed was lent at seven places including Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: That month Hanzhong and other Shaanxi areas, Yihe in Gansu, and seven places including Jilin received lent rations or seed.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩甘肅宜禾縣逋租。

translations.literal: Arrears of rent for Yihe county in Gansu were remitted or deferred.
translations.idiomatic: Yihe county's rent arrears in Gansu were remitted or deferred.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲辰，撥浙江、江西倉穀二十萬石濟福建民食。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiachen: two hundred thousand shi of granary grain from Zhejiang and Jiangxi were allocated to supply Fujian people's food.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, jiachen, 200,000 shi of Zhejiang and Jiangxi granary grain were sent to Fujian.

sentences.zh: 丙午，盧廕溥予假，命王鼎管刑部。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Lu Yinpu was granted leave and Wang Ding was ordered to supervise the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Lu Yinpu took leave and Wang Ding supervised punishments.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以孝順岱為科布多參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Xiao Shundai was made Kobdo Military Deputy Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Xiao Shundai became Kobdo deputy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸直隸災區各營兵餉，山西豐鎮等六州廳縣災民倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, troop pay was lent to camps in the Zhili disaster zone, and granary grain was lent to disaster victims in six Shanxi prefectures and counties including Fengzhen.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhili disaster-zone troops and six Shanxi places including Fengzhen received lent pay or grain.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮、南掌、琉球、暹羅入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea, Lan Xang, Ryukyu, and Siam presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Korea, Lan Xang, Ryukyu, and Siam paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 十三年春正月丁丑，臺灣嘉義匪首陳辦伏誅。

translations.literal: Year 13, spring, first month, day dingchou: Taiwan Jiayi bandit chief Chen Ban was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 13, month 1, dingchou, Taiwan bandit chief Chen Ban was executed.

sentences.zh: 己卯，升寅等查覆西安將軍徐錕贓款屬實，褫職。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Sheng Yin and others investigated and confirmed the bribery charges against Xi'an General Xu Kun and he was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Xu Kun was stripped after Sheng Yin confirmed his graft as Xi'an general.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以麟慶為湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Lin Qing was made Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Lin Qing became Hubei governor.

sentences.zh: 桃南廳決口合龍。

translations.literal: The breach at Taonan subprefecture was closed.
translations.idiomatic: The Taonan breach was sealed.

sentences.zh: 二月甲辰，上御經筵。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiachen: the Emperor presided at the classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, jiachen, the Emperor held the classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 己未，四川越巂等處夷匪作亂，命那彥寶、桂涵剿之。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Yi bandits rebelled in places including Yuexi in Sichuan; Nayinbao and Gui Han were ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Yi rebels rose in Yuexi and elsewhere in Sichuan; Nayinbao and Gui Han were sent to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 庚申，賑被災多倫諾爾租種蒙古地貧民，並諭此後口外偏災不得援請。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, poor people farming Mongol land at Dolonuur who suffered disaster were relieved, and it was ordered that henceforth partial disasters beyond the passes could not be cited in requests.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Dolonuur tenants on Mongol land were relieved and partial frontier disasters could no longer be cited in petitions.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以汪守和兼署吏部尚書。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Wang Shouhe was made acting Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Wang Shouhe acted as Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑直隸薊州等七州縣災民。

translations.literal: That month, disaster victims in seven Zhili prefectures and counties including Jizhou were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month seven Zhili places including Jizhou were relieved.

sentences.zh: 貸陝西漢中等五府州廳貧民倉穀。

translations.literal: Granary grain was lent to poor people in five Shaanxi prefectures and subprefectures including Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Poor people in five Shaanxi areas including Hanzhong received lent granary grain.

sentences.zh: 三月丙子，大學士盧廕溥致仕。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingzi: Grand Secretary Lu Yinpu retired.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, bingzi, Grand Secretary Lu Yinpu retired.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，上閱火器營兵。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, the Emperor reviewed Firearms Camp troops.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the Emperor reviewed Firearms Camp troops.

sentences.zh: 丙申，盧坤奏獲越南盜陳加海等，洋面肅清。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Lu Kun memorialized the capture of the Vietnamese pirate Chen Jiahai and others and the clearing of the sea lanes.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Lu Kun reported capturing Vietnamese pirates including Chen Jiahai and securing the seas.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以麟慶為江南河道總督。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Lin Qing was made Jiangnan Canal Director-General.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Lin Qing became Jiangnan Canal director-general.

sentences.zh: 以鄂順安為湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: E Shun'an was made Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: E Shun'an became Hubei governor.

sentences.zh: 庚子，雨。

translations.literal: On day gengzi it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi rain fell.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸直隸紫荊關營兵，奉天錦州府屬兵丁，湖南乾州等五廳縣屯丁、苗佃倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, granary grain was lent to troops at Zijing Pass camp in Zhili, soldiers under Jizhou prefecture in Fengtian, and garrison colonists and Miao tenant farmers in five Hunan subprefectures and counties including Qianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhili, Fengtian, and five Hunan places including Qianzhou received lent grain for troops and tenants.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬寅，調鄂順安為山西巡撫，尹濟源為湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day renyin: E Shun'an was transferred to Shanxi governor and Yin Jiyuan to Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4, renyin, E Shun'an took Shanxi and Yin Jiyuan took Hubei.

sentences.zh: 樂善遷福州將軍。

translations.literal: Leshan was transferred to Fuzhou general.
translations.idiomatic: Leshan became Fuzhou general.

sentences.zh: 調慶山為烏-{里}-雅蘇台將軍。

translations.literal: Qingshan was transferred to Uliastai general.
translations.idiomatic: Qingshan became Uliastai general.

sentences.zh: 丁未，雨。

translations.literal: On day dingwei it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei rain fell.

sentences.zh: 戊申，瑚松額遷成都將軍。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Husong'e was transferred to Chengdu general.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Husong'e became Chengdu general.

sentences.zh: 調寶興為盛京將軍，保昌為吉林將軍。

translations.literal: Baoxing was transferred to Mukden general and Baochang to Jilin general.
translations.idiomatic: Baoxing took Mukden and Baochang took Jilin.

sentences.zh: 以蘇成額為熱河都統，貴慶為漕運總督。

translations.literal: Su Chenge was made Rehe Commander-in-Chief and Guiqing Grand Canal transport director-general.
translations.idiomatic: Su Chenge took Rehe and Guiqing took canal transport.

sentences.zh: 己酉，命潘世恩為體仁閣大學士，管戶部。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Pan Shien was made Grand Secretary of the Hall of Embodying Benevolence and put in charge of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Pan Shien joined the Embodying Benevolence Hall and supervised revenue.

sentences.zh: 調朱士彥為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Zhu Shiyan was transferred to Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Shiyan became Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 以白鎔為工部尚書，湯金釗為左都御史。

translations.literal: Bai Rong was made Minister of Works and Tang Jinzhao Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Rong took works and Tang Jinzhao became left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，免道光十一年十二年喀什噶爾、葉爾羌額貢。

translations.literal: On day yimao, quota tribute for Kashgar and Yarkand in Daoguang 11 and 12 was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Kashgar and Yarkand quota tribute for Daoguang 11-12 was remitted.

sentences.zh: 己巳，皇后佟佳氏崩。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Empress Tonggiya died.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Empress Tonggiya died.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸盛京義州兵米、湖南新田縣民瑤籽種。

translations.literal: That month, military rice was lent at Yizhou in Fengtian and seed was lent to civilian and Yao at Xintian county in Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yizhou troops in Fengtian and civilians and Yao at Xintian in Hunan received lent rice or seed.

sentences.zh: 五月辛未朔，賜汪鳴相等二百二十人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: Fifth month, first day xinwei: Wang Mingxiang and two hundred twenty others were granted metropolitan graduate degrees with rank in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On the 1st of month 5, xinwei, 220 graduates including Wang Mingxiang received jinshi ranks.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，楊芳剿越巂夷匪，大敗之，進剿瓘邊夷匪。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Yang Fang suppressed Yi bandits at Yuexi, defeated them heavily, and advanced to suppress Yi bandits on the border.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Yang Fang heavily defeated Yuexi Yi rebels and advanced to the border campaign.

sentences.zh: 己丑，瓘邊匪首桑樹格等伏誅。

translations.literal: On day jichou, border bandit chiefs including Sang Shuge were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Sang Shuge and other border rebel chiefs were executed.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，禧恩免御前大臣、戶部尚書，改為理籓院尚書。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Xi'en was removed as Grand Minister in Attendance and Minister of Revenue and made Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Xi'en left the inner attendance and revenue posts for colonial affairs minister.

sentences.zh: 命大學士長齡管戶部，潘世恩管工部。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Changlin was ordered to superintend the Ministry of Revenue and Pan Shien the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Changlin took Revenue and Pan Shien Works.

sentences.zh: 調穆彰阿為戶部尚書，博啟圖為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Muzhang'a was transferred to Minister of Revenue and Boqitu to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Muzhang'a took Revenue and Boqitu Works.

sentences.zh: 己亥，四川瓘邊夷匪平。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the Yi bandits on the Qianbian border in Sichuan were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Sichuan Qianbian Yi bandits were pacified.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子朔，日食。

translations.literal: Sixth month, new moon on day gengzi: solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, gengzi new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸直隸博野等三縣雹災籽種。

translations.literal: That month, seed grain was loaned for hail disaster in three Zhili counties including Boye.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Boye and two other Zhili counties received hail-disaster seed loans.

sentences.zh: 七月甲申，御試翰林、詹事官，擢田嵩年三員為一等，餘升黜有差。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day jiashen: the Emperor examined Hanlin and Household officials; Tian Songnian and two others were ranked first class and the rest promoted or demoted by degree.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, jiashen, the Emperor tested Hanlin and Household officials; Tian Songnian and two others ranked first and the rest were graded.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，冊諡大行皇后為孝慎皇后。

translations.literal: On day renchen, the late Empress was given the posthumous title Xiaoshen Empress.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, the late Empress became Xiaoshen Empress.

sentences.zh: 調祁廣東巡撫，以惠吉為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: Qi was transferred to Guangdong governor and Huiji made Guangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Qi took Guangdong and Huiji Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑貴州古州等四廳縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood disaster in four Guizhou departments and counties including Guzhou was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month, four Guizhou districts including Guzhou received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 八月，是月，賑貴州都江等二廳水災。

translations.literal: Eighth month: that month, flood disaster in two Guizhou departments including Dujiang was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, two Guizhou departments including Dujiang received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午，移孝慎皇后梓宮于田村，上臨送。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengwu: the coffin of Xiaoshen Empress was moved to Tiancun and the Emperor escorted it in person.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, gengwu, Xiaoshen Empress's coffin went to Tiancun and the Emperor saw it off.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，晉楊芳一等侯。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Yang Fang was promoted to first-rank marquis.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Yang Fang became a first-rank marquis.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以貴慶為熱河都統。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Guiqing was made Rehe commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Guiqing became Rehe commandant.

sentences.zh: 調嵩溥為漕運總督。

translations.literal: Song Pu was transferred to Grand Canal transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Song Pu took the Canal transport post.

sentences.zh: 調史譜為貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: Shi Pu was transferred to Guizhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Pu became Guizhou governor.

sentences.zh: 以楊名颺為陝西巡撫。

translations.literal: Yang Mingyang was made Shaanxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Mingyang took Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 甲午，免雲南昆明等十州縣地震災本年額賦，並賑之。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, quota taxes for this year were remitted for ten Yunnan prefectures and counties including Kunming afflicted by earthquake, and relief was given.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, ten Yunnan districts including Kunming lost this year's taxes after the earthquake and received relief.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑江蘇上元等六縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood disaster in six Jiangsu counties including Shangyuan was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month, six Jiangsu counties including Shangyuan received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 十月戊午，調布彥泰為伊犁參贊大臣，常德為塔爾巴哈台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day wuwu: Buyantai was transferred to Ili councilor-assistant and Changde to Tarbagatai councilor-assistant.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10, wuwu, Buyantai went to Ili and Changde to Tarbagatai.

sentences.zh: 己未，以湯金釗為工部尚書，史致儼為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Tang Jinzhao was made Minister of Works and Shi Zhiyan Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Tang Jinzhao took Works and Shi Zhiyan the left censorate.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑江蘇上元等十二縣衛，湖南安鄉、華容二縣，直隸曲陽縣，黑龍江三處災民。

translations.literal: That month, disaster victims were relieved in twelve Jiangsu counties and guards including Shangyuan, Anxiang and Huarong in Hunan, Quyang in Zhili, and three places in Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: That month, twelve Jiangsu districts including Shangyuan, two Hunan counties, Quyang, and three Heilongjiang posts received relief.

sentences.zh: 賑湖北武昌等六縣水災。

translations.literal: Flood disaster in six Hubei counties including Wuchang was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Six Hubei counties including Wuchang received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 給安徽懷遠等六縣災民口糧。

translations.literal: Ration grain was issued to disaster victims in six Anhui counties including Huaiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Six Anhui counties including Huaiyuan received ration grain.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙戌，上詣大高殿祈雪。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingxu: the Emperor prayed for snow at the Hall of Great Height.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, bingxu, the Emperor prayed for snow at the Hall of Great Height.

sentences.zh: 以裕泰為貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: Yutai was made Guizhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: Yutai became Guizhou governor.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以武忠額為熱河都統。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Wuzhong'e was made Rehe commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Wuzhong'e became Rehe commandant.

sentences.zh: 以凱音佈署察哈爾都統。

translations.literal: Kaiyinbu acted as Chahar commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Kaiyinbu acted at Chahar.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳，減免直隸河間等五縣水淹地賦。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingsi: land taxes on flooded land were reduced or remitted in five Zhili counties including Hejian.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, dingsi, flooded-land taxes were cut in five Zhili counties including Hejian.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑江蘇上元等十二縣衛水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood disaster in twelve Jiangsu counties and guards including Shangyuan was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month, twelve Jiangsu counties and guards including Shangyuan received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮、越南、琉球、緬甸入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea, Vietnam, Ryukyu, and Burma presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Korea, Vietnam, Ryukyu, and Burma sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 十四年春正月丁卯朔，辛未，文孚免正黃旗領侍衛內大臣，以載銓代之。

translations.literal: Fourteenth year, spring, first month, new moon on day dingmao; on day xinwei, Wen Fu was dismissed as Inner Palace Grand Secretary of the Plain Yellow Banner and Zaiquan replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14, month 1, dingmao new moon; on xinwei, Wen Fu left the Plain Yellow Banner inner grand secretary post and Zaiquan replaced him.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，緬甸貢使聶紐耶公那牙卒于京師。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the Burmese tribute envoy Nie Niuyegongnaya died in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, Burma's tribute envoy Nie Niuyegongnaya died in Beijing.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，廣東儋州黎匪作亂，飭盧坤剿之。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Li bandits rebelled in Danzhou, Guangdong; Lu Kun was ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Li rebels rose in Danzhou, Guangdong, and Lu Kun was sent to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以浙江杭州等府災，免外商及浙民運米關稅。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, because of disaster in Hangzhou and other Zhejiang prefectures, transit duties on rice brought by foreign merchants and Zhejiang people were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Zhejiang disaster led to remission of rice transit duties for foreign merchants and Zhejiang shippers.

sentences.zh: 福建永安等縣土匪擄人勒贖，捕治之。

translations.literal: Bandits in Yong'an and other Fujian counties kidnapped people for ransom; they were captured and punished.
translations.idiomatic: Fujian bandits in Yong'an and elsewhere who kidnapped for ransom were captured and punished.

sentences.zh: 允浙江杭州、湖州兩府所屬漕糧紅白兼收，秈稉並納。

translations.literal: Hangzhou and Huzhou in Zhejiang were permitted to collect both red and white grain tribute and accept both indica and japonica rice.
translations.idiomatic: Hangzhou and Huzhou tribute grain could mix red and white grain and both indica and japonica rice.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，命潘世恩在軍機大臣上行走。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, Pan Shien was ordered to serve on the Grand Council above the rank of Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Pan Shien was placed above ordinary Grand Councilors on the Council.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以三載考績予長齡等議敘。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, after three-year merit review, Changlin and others were recorded for promotion.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, three-year review recorded Changlin and others for promotion.

sentences.zh: 命松筠以都統銜休致。

translations.literal: Songyun was ordered to retire with the rank of commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Songyun retired with commandant rank.

sentences.zh: 祁奏越南諒山解圍，七泉夷州知州阮文泉等求入關，拒之。

translations.literal: Qi memorialized that Lang Son in Vietnam had been relieved; Ruan Wenquan, magistrate of Qiquan Yizhou, and others sought to enter the border and were refused.
translations.idiomatic: Qi reported Lang Son relieved; Ruan Wenquan of Qiquan Yizhou and others asked to cross the border and were refused.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑直隸曲陽縣貧民。

translations.literal: That month, the poor of Quyang County, Zhili, were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Quyang's poor received relief.

sentences.zh: 給江蘇上元等八縣、浙江海寧等四州縣、江西南昌等二十二縣上年災歉口糧籽種。

translations.literal: Ration grain and seed grain were issued for last year's failed harvests in eight Jiangsu counties including Shangyuan, four Zhejiang prefectures and counties including Haining, and twenty-two Jiangxi counties including Nanchang.
translations.idiomatic: Last year's failed harvests in eight Jiangsu counties, four Zhejiang districts, and twenty-two Jiangxi counties received ration and seed grain.

sentences.zh: 貸山西朔州等十州縣、陝西葭州等十四州廳縣、江西南昌等六縣、湖北武昌等十八州縣衛、湖南澧州等四州縣、甘肅皋蘭等九州廳縣上年被災倉穀口糧籽種。

translations.literal: Granary grain, ration grain, and seed grain were loaned for last year's disasters in ten Shanxi prefectures and counties including Shuozhou, fourteen Shaanxi prefectures and counties including Jiazhou, six Jiangxi counties including Nanchang, eighteen Hubei prefectures, counties, and guards including Wuchang, four Hunan prefectures and counties including Lizhou, and nine Gansu prefectures and counties including Gaolan.
translations.idiomatic: Last year's disasters in Shanxi, Shaanxi, Jiangxi, Hubei, Hunan, and Gansu districts received granary, ration, and seed loans.

sentences.zh: 二月丙申朔，朱士彥給假省親，以湯金釗署吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Second month, new moon on day bingshen: Zhu Shiyan was granted leave to visit his parents and Tang Jinzhao acted as Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, bingshen new moon, Zhu Shiyan went home on leave and Tang Jinzhao acted at Personnel.

sentences.zh: 改巴爾楚克換防總兵為副將。

translations.literal: The garrison chief at exchange-post Balkh was changed to vice commander.
translations.idiomatic: Balkh exchange-post garrison chief became vice commander.

sentences.zh: 己亥，上御經筵。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the Emperor attended the classics lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the Emperor attended the classics lecture.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，升寅等查辦山東、河南事件，以敬徵署左都御史。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Sheng Yin and others were sent to investigate affairs in Shandong and Henan; Jingzheng acted as Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Sheng Yin and others investigated Shandong and Henan affairs; Jingzheng acted at the left censorate.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，釋李鴻賓、劉榮慶回籍。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Li Hongbin and Liu Rongqing were released to return home.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Li Hongbin and Liu Rongqing were freed to go home.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以江蘇糧價增昂，免四川、湖廣商米各關船稅。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, because Jiangsu grain prices rose, boat duties on merchant grain from Sichuan and Huguang at each pass were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, rising Jiangsu grain prices led to remission of boat duties on Sichuan and Huguang merchant grain.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以廣東學政李泰交自縊，命盧坤徹查。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Guangdong education intendant Li Taijiao hanged himself; Lu Kun was ordered to investigate thoroughly.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Guangdong intendant Li Taijiao hanged himself and Lu Kun was ordered to investigate.

sentences.zh: 己酉，定山東運河查泉章程。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, regulations were fixed for inspecting springs along the Shandong transport canal.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Shandong canal spring-inspection regulations were fixed.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以謁西陵，命奕紹等留京辦事。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, for visits to the Western Tombs, Yishao and others were ordered to remain in the capital to conduct affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, for the Western Tombs visit, Yishao and others stayed in Beijing to govern.

sentences.zh: 壬子，命凱音布查辦烏-{里}-雅蘇台事件。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Kaiyinbu was ordered to investigate affairs at Uliastai.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Kaiyinbu was sent to investigate Uliastai affairs.

sentences.zh: 以蘇勒通阿署察哈爾都統。

translations.literal: Suletong'a acted as Chahar commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Suletong'a acted at Chahar.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，朱士彥憂免，調湯金釗為吏部尚書，以汪守和為工部尚書，史致儼為禮部尚書，何淩漢為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Zhu Shiyan was dismissed for mourning; Tang Jinzhao was transferred to Minister of Personnel, Wang Shouhe made Minister of Works, Shi Zhiyan Minister of Rites, and He Linghan Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Zhu Shiyan mourned out; Tang Jinzhao took Personnel, Wang Shouhe Works, Shi Zhiyan Rites, and He Linghan the left censorate.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，大學士富俊卒。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Grand Secretary Fujun died.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Grand Secretary Fujun died.

sentences.zh: 是月，給江蘇上元等八縣衛上年被災口糧。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was issued for last year's disasters in eight Jiangsu counties and guards including Shangyuan.
translations.idiomatic: That month, eight Jiangsu counties and guards including Shangyuan received last year's disaster rations.

sentences.zh: 貸貴州古州廳上年被災籽種。

translations.literal: Seed grain was loaned for last year's disaster in Guzhou Department, Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou's Guzhou Department received a seed loan for last year's disaster.

sentences.zh: 三月庚午，明山病免，以成格為刑部尚書，那清安兼署。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengwu: Mingshan was dismissed on account of illness; Chengge was made Minister of Punishments and Na Qing'an also acted.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, gengwu, Mingshan left for illness; Chengge took Punishments and Na Qing'an acted.

sentences.zh: 以長清為烏魯木齊都統，興德為葉爾羌參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Chang Qing was made Urumchi commandant and Xingde Yarkand councilor-assistant.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Qing took Urumchi and Xingde Yarkand.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，上謁西陵，詣田村孝慎皇后梓宮前奠酒，免經過額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, the Emperor visited the Western Tombs, offered wine before Xiaoshen Empress's coffin at Tiancun, and remitted three-tenths of quota taxes along the route.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the Emperor visited the Western Tombs, poured wine at Tiancun before Xiaoshen Empress's coffin, and cut route taxes by three-tenths.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，上謁泰陵、泰東陵、昌陵。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the Emperor visited Tailing, Taidongling, and Changling.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the Emperor visited Tailing, Taidongling, and Changling.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 壬午，上臨故大學士富俊第賜奠。

translations.literal: On day renwu, the Emperor visited the late Grand Secretary Fujun's residence and bestowed sacrificial gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, the Emperor mourned at Grand Secretary Fujun's house.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以喀爾喀遊牧被災，准凱音布請，緩勘地界。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, because Khalkha pastures suffered disaster, Kaiyinbu's request to defer border surveys was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Khalkha pasture disaster led to approval of Kaiyinbu's request to defer border surveys.

sentences.zh: 免四川夷匪滋擾之清溪等三廳縣，並寧越、越巂兩營上年額賦。

translations.literal: Quota taxes for last year were remitted for three Sichuan departments and counties including Qingxi harassed by Yi bandits and for the two garrisons of Ningyue and Yuexi.
translations.idiomatic: Last year's taxes were remitted for three Sichuan districts including Qingxi and the Ningyue and Yuexi garrisons.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁酉，以給事中黃爵滋奏，命各省督撫興復書院，選擇山長，查保甲，修水利，籌積貯，嚴禁扣餉派兵積弊，查究偷漏洋稅，並禁紋銀出洋及私鑄洋銀。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dingyou: on memorial of supervising censor Huang Juezi, each province's governor and governor-general was ordered to revive academies and select mountain chiefs, inspect household registers, repair waterworks, stock granaries, strictly forbid abuses of deducting pay and dispatching troops, investigate smuggling of foreign customs duties, and forbid silver export and private casting of foreign silver.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4, dingyou, Huang Juezi's memorial ordered governors to revive academies, inspect registers, repair waterworks, stock grain, stop pay abuses, and curb foreign-duty smuggling and silver export.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，除直隸樂亭縣水沖官地租賦。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, rents on official land washed away by water in Leting County, Zhili, were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Leting's water-washed official land rents were abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁未，儀郡王綿志卒。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Prince of Yi Commandery Mianzhi died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Prince of Yi Commandery Mianzhi died.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，臨故儀順郡王綿志第賜奠。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, the Emperor visited the late Prince of Yishun Commandery Mianzhi's residence and bestowed sacrificial gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the Emperor mourned at Prince of Yishun Mianzhi's house.

sentences.zh: 以其子奕絪襲貝勒。

translations.literal: His son Yiyin inherited as beile.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yiyin became beile.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，命侍郎趙盛奎、在籍前河督嚴烺會同富呢揚阿查勘浙江塘工。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Vice Minister Zhao Shengkui and retired former Yellow River governor Yan Huang were ordered to join Funiyang'a in surveying Zhejiang seawall works.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Zhao Shengkui and Yan Huang joined Funiyang'a to survey Zhejiang seawalls.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以蘇清阿為伊犁參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Su Qing'a was made Ili councilor-assistant.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Su Qing'a became Ili councilor-assistant.

sentences.zh: 甲子，上詣田村孝慎皇后梓宮前行周年祭禮。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the Emperor performed the first anniversary rites at Xiaoshen Empress's coffin at Tiancun.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the Emperor held the first anniversary rite at Tiancun for Xiaoshen Empress.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸山西岳陽等十二州廳縣歉收民屯倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, granary grain was loaned to civilian farming colonies in twelve Shanxi prefectures, departments, and counties including Yueyang that had poor harvests.
translations.idiomatic: That month, twelve Shanxi districts including Yueyang received granary loans for poor harvests in civilian colonies.

sentences.zh: 五月己巳，以恩銘署漕運總督。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jisi: Enming acted as Grand Canal transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, jisi, Enming acted as Canal transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 壬申，授凱音布察哈爾都統。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Kaiyinbu was appointed Chahar commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Kaiyinbu became Chahar commandant.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，免雲南昆明等十州縣上年地震災賦。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, taxes for last year's earthquake in ten Yunnan prefectures and counties including Kunming were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, ten Yunnan districts including Kunming lost last year's earthquake taxes.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，上至田村孝慎皇后梓宮前奠酒。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, the Emperor offered wine at Xiaoshen Empress's coffin at Tiancun.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, the Emperor poured wine at Tiancun before Xiaoshen Empress's coffin.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，命盧坤等驅逐英吉利販鴉片躉船，勿任停泊。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Lu Kun and others were ordered to drive away British opium depot ships and not allow them to anchor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Lu Kun and others were told to expel British opium depot ships and forbid anchorage.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，修山東闕里至聖孔子林、廟。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the forest and temple of Confucius at Qufu in Shandong were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Qufu's Confucian forest and temple were repaired.

sentences.zh: 甲午，申諭多爾濟喇布坦等與俄羅斯交涉事件務遵舊章。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, an injunction was sent that Dorji Labutan and others must follow old regulations in dealings with Russia.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Dorji Labutan and others were told to follow old rules in Russian dealings.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸淮安、大河二衛歉收屯田籽種。

translations.literal: That month, seed grain was loaned to farming colonies in Huai'an and Dahe guards that had poor harvests.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Huai'an and Dahe guards received seed loans for poor harvests.

sentences.zh: 六月戊申，以福建省城水災，准運古田、福清二縣倉穀及廈門商販米平糶。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wushen: because of flood in Fujian's provincial capital, grain from Gutian and Fuqing county granaries and merchant rice at Xiamen was permitted to be sold at fair price.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, wushen, Fujian capital flooding led to fair-price sale of Gutian and Fuqing granary grain and Xiamen merchant rice.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以鄂爾多斯達拉特旗私租蒙地民人拒捕傷台吉，命鄂順安捕治之。

translations.literal: On day guichou, because people privately leasing Mongol land in Ordos Dala Banner resisted arrest and wounded a taiji, Eshun'an was ordered to capture and punish them.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Ordos Dala Banner tenants who wounded a taiji resisting arrest were to be seized by Eshun'an.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，實授恩銘漕運總督。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Enming was formally appointed Grand Canal transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Enming became Canal transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 是月，蠲緩葉爾羌等三城回戶逋糧。

translations.literal: That month, overdue grain taxes of Muslim households in three cities including Yarkand were remitted or deferred.
translations.idiomatic: That month, overdue grain taxes in three cities including Yarkand were remitted or deferred.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙丑，飭查漕運虧短積弊，並申禁京城私販接濟回漕。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day yichou: investigation was ordered into accumulated abuses of shortfall on canal transport, and private sale in the capital to supply returning tribute grain was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, yichou, canal transport shortfalls were to be investigated and capital sales feeding returning tribute grain were banned.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，博啟圖給假，以奕顥署工部尚書。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Boqitu was granted leave and Yihao acted as Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Boqitu took leave and Yihao acted at Works.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，霍罕伯克以准通商免稅，遣使表貢，並請年班入覲，允之。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, the Kokand begs, granted duty-free trade, sent envoys with memorial and tribute and requested annual audience; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Kokand begs with duty-free trade sent tribute and asked for annual audience; it was allowed.

sentences.zh: 庚午，命蘇清阿查勘巴爾楚克、喀什噶爾墾田。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Su Qing'a was ordered to survey reclaimed fields at Balkh and Kashgar.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Su Qing'a surveyed reclaimed fields at Balkh and Kashgar.

sentences.zh: 免福建臺匪滋擾之四縣，暨淡水廳抄叛各產租穀。

translations.literal: Four Fujian counties harassed by Taiwan bandits and rented grain from rebellious confiscations in Tamsui Department were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Four Taiwan-troubled Fujian counties and Tamsui confiscated rebel rents were remitted.

sentences.zh: 壬申，命特依順保等妥議沿邊會哨章程。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Te Yishunbao and others were ordered to deliberate properly on frontier patrol regulations.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Te Yishunbao and others were to settle frontier patrol rules.

sentences.zh: 程祖洛奏獲洋盜劉四等誅之。

translations.literal: Cheng Zuluo memorialized that foreign pirate Liu Si and others had been captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Zuluo reported foreign pirate Liu Si and others captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，四川瓘邊廳支夷作亂，命瑚松額、楊芳等查辦。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, branch Yi in Qianbian Department, Sichuan, rebelled; Husong'e, Yang Fang, and others were ordered to investigate and handle it.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Sichuan Qianbian branch Yi rebelled; Husong'e, Yang Fang, and others were sent to handle it.

sentences.zh: 賑江西水災。

translations.literal: Jiangxi flood disaster was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangxi flood victims received relief.

sentences.zh: 丙子，工部尚書博啟圖卒，調耆英為工部尚書，陞寅為禮部尚書，敬徵為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Minister of Works Boqitu died; Qiying was transferred to Minister of Works, Sheng Yin to Minister of Rites, and Jingzheng to Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Boqitu died; Qiying took Works, Sheng Yin Rites, and Jingzheng the left censorate.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以桂良為河南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Guiliang was made Henan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Guiliang became Henan governor.

sentences.zh: 戊子，東河朱家灣決口。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, the Yellow River burst its banks at Zhujiawan on the Eastern River.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, the Yellow River broke at Zhujiawan on the Eastern River.
