sentences.zh: 是月，賑江西南昌等十三縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood disaster in thirteen Jiangxi counties including Nanchang was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month, thirteen Jiangxi counties including Nanchang received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 給湖南武陵等七縣衛被水軍民口糧並修屋費。

translations.literal: Rations and house-repair funds were issued to soldiers and civilians flooded in seven Hunan counties and guards including Wuling.
translations.idiomatic: Wuling and six other Hunan districts received flood rations and repair funds.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，改建浙江北海塘為石塘。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiyou: Zhejiang's northern sea wall at Beitang was rebuilt as a stone dike.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou in the eighth month, Zhejiang's Beitang sea wall became a stone dike.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以武忠額為烏-{里}-雅蘇台將軍，倫布多爾濟署。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Wuzhong'e was made Uliassutai general with Lunbuduo'erji acting.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Wuzhong'e took Uliassutai and Lunbuduo'erji acted.

sentences.zh: 以嵩溥為熱河都統。

translations.literal: Songpu was made Rehe military governor.
translations.idiomatic: Songpu became Rehe military governor.

sentences.zh: 庚申，四川瓘邊支夷平。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, the sub-tribes on Sichuan's Qian border were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Sichuan's Qian border tribes were pacified.

sentences.zh: 盧坤奏英商律勞卑來粵，致書稱大英國，請暫停貿易。

translations.literal: Lu Kun reported that the English merchant Napier had come to Canton, wrote letters styling himself as Great Britain, and asked that trade be suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Kun reported Napier's arrival at Canton, British-letter arrogance, and a request to halt trade.

sentences.zh: 諭是之。

translations.literal: An edict approved this.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，上詣孝慎皇后梓宮前奠茶酒。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, the Emperor offered tea and wine before Empress Xiaoshen's coffin-palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the Emperor mourned at Empress Xiaoshen's coffin.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑盛京蓋州等三處，浙江建德、淳安二縣，江西南昌等二十五縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood relief was given at three places in Mukden including Gaizhou, Jiande and Chun'an in Zhejiang, and twenty-five counties in Jiangxi including Nanchang.
translations.idiomatic: That month, floods were relieved in Mukden, Zhejiang, and Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 貸甘肅皋蘭等六縣旱災倉穀。

translations.literal: Granary grain was loaned for drought in six Gansu counties including Gaolan.
translations.idiomatic: Gaolan and five other Gansu counties received drought grain loans.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩江西南昌等二十五州縣新舊額賦。

translations.literal: Old and new quota taxes were remitted and deferred for twenty-five Jiangxi prefectures and counties including Nanchang.
translations.idiomatic: Nanchang and twenty-four other Jiangxi districts received tax remissions.

sentences.zh: 九月乙丑，英吉利兵船入廣東內河，褫盧坤職留任。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yichou: English warships entered the inner reaches of Guangdong; Lu Kun was stripped of rank but retained in office.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month on yichou, British warships entered Guangdong's inner river and Lu Kun was demoted yet kept in post.

sentences.zh: 庚午，上閱健銳營兵。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, the Emperor reviewed troops of the Vanguard Camp.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, the Emperor reviewed Vanguard Camp troops.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，英吉利兵船出口，復盧坤太子少保，仍革職留任。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, when the English warships left port, Lu Kun was restored as Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent but still dismissed from office yet retained in post.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, after British ships left, Lu Kun regained Junior Heir Apparent Tutor rank but remained dismissed yet in post.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑直隸宛平等七州縣水災，奉天新民等四州縣廳水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood relief was given in seven Zhili prefectures and counties including Wanping and four Fengtian prefectures, counties, and subprefectures including Xinmin.
translations.idiomatic: That month, floods were relieved in Zhili and Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 貸廣東廣州、肇慶二府水災籽種，打牲烏拉被水旗民倉穀。

translations.literal: Seed grain was loaned for floods in Guangdong's Guangzhou and Zhaoqing prefectures; granary grain to flooded Banner people of the hunting Ula.
translations.idiomatic: Guangzhou, Zhaoqing, and flooded Ula Banner people received seed and grain loans.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩直隸大城等五十一州縣、山西太原縣水災新舊額賦。

translations.literal: Old and new quota taxes were remitted and deferred for floods in fifty-one Zhili prefectures and counties including Dacheng and Taiyuan County, Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Dacheng and fifty other districts plus Taiyuan received flood tax remissions.

sentences.zh: 十月己酉，立皇貴妃鈕祜祿氏為皇后，頒詔加恩有差。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day jiyou: Imperial Noble Consort of the Niuhuru clan was made Empress; an edict granted differentiated favors.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou in the tenth month, Niuhuru was made Empress and favors were announced.

sentences.zh: 壬子，上皇太后徽號曰恭慈安豫康成莊惠皇太后，頒詔覃恩有差。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the Emperor conferred on the Empress Dowager the honorific title "Reverent, Kind, Tranquil, Prosperous, Accomplished, Solemn, Bountiful Empress Dowager"; an edict granted broad differentiated favors.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the Empress Dowager received a new honorific title and broad favors were granted.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，那清安病免，以敬徵為兵部尚書，奕顥為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Na Qing'an was dismissed for illness; Jingzheng was made Minister of War and Yihao Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Na Qing'an left office; Jingzheng took War and Yihao the Left Censorate.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑湖北黃梅等三縣衛、湖南安鄉等四縣衛水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood relief was given in three Hubei counties and guards including Huangmei and four Hunan counties and guards including Anxiang.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Huangmei and Anxiang districts received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 貸甘肅皋蘭等八州縣旱災雹災口糧。

translations.literal: Ration grain was loaned for drought and hail in eight Gansu prefectures and counties including Gaolan.
translations.idiomatic: Gaolan and seven other Gansu districts received drought and hail ration loans.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙丑，調汪守和為禮部尚書，史致儼為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day yichou: Wang Shouhe was transferred to Minister of Rites and Shi Zhiyi Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou in the eleventh month, Wang Shouhe took Rites and Shi Zhiyi Works.

sentences.zh: 壬申，禮部尚書升寅卒，以奕顥為禮部尚書，恩銘為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Minister of Rites Shengyin died; Yihao was made Minister of Rites and Enming Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Shengyin died; Yihao took Rites and Enming the Left Censorate.

sentences.zh: 調朱為弼為漕運總督。

translations.literal: Zhu Weibi was transferred to Grand Canal transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Weibi became canal transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以棍楚克策楞為塔爾巴哈台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Gunchuke Celeng was made Tarbagatai assistant military governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Gunchuke Celeng became Tarbagatai assistant governor.

sentences.zh: 己卯，刑部尚書戴敦元卒，調史致儼代之。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Minister of Punishments Dai Dunyuan died; Shi Zhiyi was transferred to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Dai Dunyuan died and Shi Zhiyi replaced him at Punishments.

sentences.zh: 以王引之為工部尚書。

translations.literal: Wang Yinzhi was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yinzhi became Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以烏爾恭額為浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Wuergong'e was made Zhejiang governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Wuergong'e became Zhejiang governor.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以文孚為大學士管吏部。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Wen Fu was made Grand Secretary superintending the Board of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Wen Fu became Grand Secretary over Personnel.

sentences.zh: 調穆彰阿為吏部尚書、協辦大學士，耆英為戶部尚書，敬徵為工部尚書，奕顥為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Muzhang'a was transferred to Minister of Personnel and associate Grand Secretary; Qiying Minister of Revenue; Jingzheng Minister of Works; Yihao Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: Muzhang'a took Personnel and became associate Grand Secretary; Qiying Revenue; Jingzheng Works; Yihao War.

sentences.zh: 以載銓為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Zaiquan was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Zaiquan became Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 工部尚書王引之卒。

translations.literal: Minister of Works Wang Yinzhi died.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yinzhi died.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以何淩漢為工部尚書，吳椿為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, He Linghan was made Minister of Works and Wu Chun Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, He Linghan took Works and Wu Chun the Left Censorate.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑浙江麗水縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood disaster in Lishui County, Zhejiang, was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Lishui received flood relief.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩浙江建德等十六州縣衛水災新舊額賦。

translations.literal: Old and new quota taxes were remitted and deferred for floods in sixteen Zhejiang prefectures, counties, and guards including Jiande.
translations.idiomatic: Jiande and fifteen other Zhejiang districts received flood tax remissions.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸巳，霍罕復侵色埒庫勒，命興德等諭之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jisi: Kokand again invaded Selikul; Xingde and others were ordered to admonish them.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi in the twelfth month, Kokand invaded Selikul again and Xingde was sent to remonstrate.

sentences.zh: 命文孚為東閣大學士。

translations.literal: Wen Fu was ordered made Eastern Pavilion Grand Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Fu became Eastern Pavilion Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 丙申，四川瓘邊夷匪復叛，降楊芳二等侯，褫御前侍衛，以總兵候補。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Yi bandits on Sichuan's Qian border rebelled again; Yang Fang was reduced to second-rank marquis, stripped of imperial bodyguard status, and placed on reserve as regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, Qian border Yi rebelled again; Yang Fang was demoted to second-rank marquis and lost bodyguard rank.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，黑龍江將軍富僧德調西安將軍，以奕經代之。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, Heilongjiang general Fusengde was transferred to Xi'an general; Yijing replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Fusengde went to Xi'an and Yijing to Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，上詣大高殿祈雪。

translations.literal: On day guichou, the Emperor prayed for snow at the Dagao Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, the Emperor prayed for snow at Dagao.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸直隸災區各營兵餉，江甯八旗官兵銀米，廣東南海等九縣籽種並圍基修費。

translations.literal: That month, pay was loaned to camp troops in Zhili disaster areas; silver and grain to Jiangning Eight Banner officers and soldiers; seed and embankment-repair funds to nine Guangdong counties including Nanhai.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Zhili troops, Jiangning Banner troops, and nine Guangdong counties received loans and repair funds.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮、琉球、緬甸、暹羅入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea, Ryukyu, Burma, and Siam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Korea, Ryukyu, Burma, and Siam paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 十五年春正月甲子，大學士曹振鏞卒。

translations.literal: Fifteenth year, spring, first month, day jiazi: Grand Secretary Cao Zhenyong died.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 15, on jiazi, Cao Zhenyong died.

sentences.zh: 壬午，長齡以受霍罕餽送，罷御前大臣管戶部事。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Changling, for accepting Kokand gifts, was removed as imperial attendant minister managing the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Changling lost his attendant minister post over Kokand gifts.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，陝甘總督楊遇春致仕，仍溫諭來京。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general Yang Yuchun retired but was warmly ordered to come to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Yang Yuchun retired yet was invited warmly to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 以瑚松額為陝甘總督。

translations.literal: Husong'e was made Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Husong'e became Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.

sentences.zh: 調寶興成都將軍。

translations.literal: Baoxing was transferred to Chengdu general.
translations.idiomatic: Baoxing became Chengdu general.

sentences.zh: 以奕經為盛京將軍，保昌為黑龍江將軍，蘇清阿為吉林將軍。

translations.literal: Yijing was made Mukden general; Baochang Heilongjiang general; Suqing'a Jilin general.
translations.idiomatic: Yijing took Mukden, Baochang Heilongjiang, and Suqing'a Jilin.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑奉天牛莊等三處被災旗戶。

translations.literal: That month, disaster-struck Banner households at three places in Fengtian including Niuzhuang were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Niuzhuang and two other Fengtian Banner districts were relieved.

sentences.zh: 給江西南昌等九縣，甘肅靖遠等六州縣口糧。

translations.literal: Rations were issued in nine Jiangxi counties including Nanchang and six Gansu prefectures and counties including Jingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Nanchang and eight other Jiangxi counties and six Gansu districts received rations.

sentences.zh: 貸山西太原等三州縣，江西南昌等二十六州縣，湖南安鄉等四州縣，甘肅秦州、靖遠縣被災倉穀籽種。

translations.literal: Granary grain and seed were loaned to disaster victims in three Shanxi prefectures and counties including Taiyuan, twenty-six Jiangxi prefectures and counties including Nanchang, four Hunan prefectures and counties including Anxiang, and Qinzhou and Jingyuan, Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: Disaster districts in Shanxi, Jiangxi, Hunan, and Gansu received grain and seed loans.

sentences.zh: 二月丙申，以阮元為大學士管刑部，王鼎協辦大學士，伊-{里}-布為雲貴總督，何煊為雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingshen: Ruan Yuan was made Grand Secretary superintending Punishments; Wang Ding associate Grand Secretary; Yilibu Yunnan-Guizhou governor-general; He Xuan Yunnan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the second month, Ruan Yuan took Punishments, Wang Ding became associate Grand Secretary, Yilibu Yunnan-Guizhou, and He Xuan Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以奇明保署黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Qimingbao was ordered to act as Heilongjiang general.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Qimingbao acted as Heilongjiang general.

sentences.zh: 丁未，命長齡管理籓院，文孚管戶部，潘世恩管工部，阮元改管兵部，王鼎管刑部。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Changling was ordered to manage the Court of Colonial Affairs; Wen Fu Revenue; Pan Shien Works; Ruan Yuan was reassigned to War; Wang Ding Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Changling took Colonial Affairs, Wen Fu Revenue, Pan Works, Ruan War, and Wang Ding Punishments.

sentences.zh: 以朝鮮世孫李奐襲封朝鮮國王。

translations.literal: Li Huan, Korean royal heir, was invested as King of Korea.
translations.idiomatic: Li Huan succeeded as King of Korea.

sentences.zh: 戊午，吉林將軍蘇清阿卒，調保昌代之。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Jilin general Suqing'a died; Baochang was transferred to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Suqing'a died and Baochang replaced him at Jilin.

sentences.zh: 以祥康為黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: Xiangkang was made Heilongjiang general.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangkang became Heilongjiang general.

sentences.zh: 三月，山西趙城縣匪曹順作亂，知事楊延亮死之，遂圍霍州。

translations.literal: Third month: bandit Cao Shun rebelled in Zhaocheng County, Shanxi; prefectural judge Yang Yanliang died resisting and they then besieged Huozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, Cao Shun rebelled at Zhaocheng, Yang Yanliang fell, and Huozhou was besieged.

sentences.zh: 命鄂順安剿辦。

translations.literal: E Shun'an was ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: E Shun'an was sent to suppress the rebels.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，上親耕耤田。

translations.literal: On day yihai, the Emperor personally plowed the ceremonial field.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the Emperor plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 幸南苑行圍。

translations.literal: He visited the Southern Park for the hunt enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor went to the Southern Park to hunt.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 是月，給甘肅皋蘭等五州縣廳災歉口糧。

translations.literal: That month, rations were issued for crop failure in five Gansu prefectures, counties, and subprefectures including Gaolan.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Gaolan and four other Gansu districts received famine rations.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，四川瓘邊支夷平，晉鄂山太子太保，賞雙眼花翎。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month: Sichuan's Qian border sub-tribes were pacified; E Shan was promoted to Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent and given double-eyed peacock feathers.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Qian border tribes were pacified and E Shan gained Grand Guardian rank and peacock feathers.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，賜劉繹等二百七十六人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day jiayin, 276 men including Liu Yi were granted advanced scholar and palace graduate ranks with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, 276 graduates including Liu Yi received jinshi honors with distinctions.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，上詣黑龍潭神祠祈雨。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, the Emperor prayed for rain at the Black Dragon Pool shrine.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, the Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 五月丁卯，致仕陝甘總督楊遇春晉封一等侯，予食全俸。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingmao: retired Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general Yang Yuchun was advanced to first-rank marquis with full salary.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the fifth month, retired Yang Yuchun became a first-rank marquis at full pay.

sentences.zh: 辛未，趙城縣匪首曹順等伏誅。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, bandit chiefs Cao Shun and others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Cao Shun and fellow leaders were executed.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，上復詣黑龍潭神祠祈雨。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, the Emperor again prayed for rain at the Black Dragon Pool shrine.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the Emperor again prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 以栗毓美為河東河道總督。

translations.literal: Li Yumei was made Grand Canal east-route governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yumei became east-route canal governor-general.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，雨。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, it rained.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸山西鳳臺、沁水二縣被旱倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, granary grain was loaned for drought in two Shanxi counties, Fengtai and Qinshui.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Fengtai and Qinshui received drought grain loans.

sentences.zh: 六月丙午，減江蘇丹徒被水蘆田額賦。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingwu: quota taxes on flooded reed fields in Dantu, Jiangsu, were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the sixth month, Dantu flooded reed-field taxes were cut.

sentences.zh: 閏六月丁卯，敬徵降調，以載銓為工部尚書，恩銘為禮部尚書，武忠額為左都御史。

translations.literal: Intercalary sixth month, day dingmao: Jingzheng was demoted and transferred; Zaiquan Minister of Works; Enming Minister of Rites; Wuzhong'e Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the intercalary sixth month, Jingzheng was demoted, Zaiquan took Works, Enming Rites, and Wuzhong'e the Left Censorate.

sentences.zh: 調保昌為烏-{里}-雅蘇台將軍，祥康為吉林將軍，哈豐阿為黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: Baochang was transferred to Uliassutai general; Xiangkang Jilin general; Hafeng'a Heilongjiang general.
translations.idiomatic: Baochang went to Uliassutai, Xiangkang to Jilin, and Hafeng'a to Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 己巳，停本年秋決。

translations.literal: On day jisi, this autumn's executions were suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, autumn executions were halted.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰，文孚免軍機大臣，仍命以大學士管吏部。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day jiachen: Wen Fu was removed as Grand Councilor but still ordered to serve as Grand Secretary superintending Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the seventh month, Wen Fu left the Grand Council yet kept Personnel as Grand Secretary.

sentences.zh: 改潘世恩管戶部，穆彰阿管工部。

translations.literal: Pan Shien was reassigned to manage Revenue; Muzhang'a Works.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Shien took Revenue and Muzhang'a Works.

sentences.zh: 命刑部右侍郎趙盛奎、工部右侍郎賽尚阿在軍機大臣上學習行走。

translations.literal: Right Vice Minister of Punishments Zhao Shengkui and Right Vice Minister of Works Saishang'a were ordered to study under the Grand Councilors.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Shengkui and Saishang'a were assigned to train with the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 是月，給陝西沔縣、洛川縣被水，湖南華容等三縣衛被旱口糧。

translations.literal: That month, rations were issued for floods in Mian and Luochuan counties, Shaanxi, and drought in three Hunan counties and guards including Huarong.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Mian, Luochuan, and Huarong districts received disaster rations.

sentences.zh: 八月甲子，以皇太后六旬萬壽，普免各省逋賦。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiazi: for the Empress Dowager's sixtieth birthday, overdue taxes in all provinces were universally remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the eighth month, overdue provincial taxes were remitted for the Empress Dowager's sixtieth birthday.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，諭：「科道中馮贊勳、金應麟、黃爵滋、曾望顏擢任京卿，所以廣開忠諫，務當不避嫌怨，于民生國計用人行政闕失，仍隨時據實直陳，以資採納。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, an edict said: "Censorial officials Feng Zunxun, Jin Yinglin, Huang Juezi, and Zeng Wangyan have been promoted to metropolitan offices so that loyal remonstrance may be broadened. You must not avoid grudges; whenever there are failures in people's livelihood, state policy, appointments and administration, or governance, still report the facts frankly at any time so they may be adopted."
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, an edict promoted four censors to broaden remonstrance and ordered frank reporting on governance failures without avoiding grudges.

sentences.zh: 」兩廣總督盧坤卒，以鄧廷楨為兩廣總督，祁署，色卜星額為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: Guangdong-Guangxi governor-general Lu Kun died; Deng Tingzhen was made governor-general with Qi acting; Sebuxing'e Anhui governor.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Kun died; Deng Tingzhen became governor-general with Qi acting and Sebuxing'e Anhui governor.

sentences.zh: 甲申，上謁西陵。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, the Emperor visited the Western Tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, the Emperor visited the Western Tombs.

sentences.zh: 是日，移孝慎皇后梓宮由田村啟行，免經過地方額賦十之五。

translations.literal: That day, Empress Xiaoshen's coffin-palace was moved from Tiancun; five-tenths of quota taxes along the route were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That day, Empress Xiaoshen's coffin left Tiancun and route taxes were cut by half.

sentences.zh: 是月，給陝西府穀縣雹災口糧。

translations.literal: That month, hail-disaster rations were issued in Fugu County, Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Fugu received hail rations.

sentences.zh: 九月己丑，孝穆皇后、孝慎皇后梓宮至龍泉峪，上臨奠。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jichou: coffin-palaces of Empresses Xiaomu and Xiaoshen reached Longquanyu; the Emperor mourned in person.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou in the ninth month, both empresses' coffins reached Longquanyu and the Emperor mourned there.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，上回鑾。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，授麟慶江南河道總督。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Lin Qing was appointed Jiangnan canal-route governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Lin Qing became Jiangnan canal governor-general.

sentences.zh: 丙午，朱為弼病免，以恩特亨額為漕運總督。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Zhu Weibi was dismissed for illness; Enteheng'e was made Grand Canal transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Zhu Weibi left office and Enteheng'e became canal transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 是月，給兩淮板浦、中正二場被水灶丁口糧。

translations.literal: That month, rations were issued to saltern households flooded at two Lianghuai fields, Banpu and Zhongzheng.
translations.idiomatic: That month, flooded Banpu and Zhongzheng saltern workers received rations.

sentences.zh: 緩徵陝西榆林縣、葭州雹災，江西金谿等九縣旱災額賦。

translations.literal: Quota taxes were deferred for hail in Yulin County and Jia Prefecture, Shaanxi, and drought in nine Jiangxi counties including Jinxi.
translations.idiomatic: Yulin, Jia, and nine Jiangxi counties including Jinxi received tax deferrals.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊午，以毓書為科布多參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day wuwu: Yushu was made Kobdo assistant military governor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu in the tenth month, Yushu became Kobdo assistant governor.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以皇太后六旬聖壽，上徽號曰恭慈康豫安成莊惠壽禧皇太后。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, for the Empress Dowager's sixtieth sacred birthday, the honorific title "Reverent, Kind, Prosperous, Tranquil, Accomplished, Solemn, Bountiful, Longevous, Auspicious Empress Dowager" was conferred.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the Empress Dowager received a sixtieth-birthday honorific title.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，皇太后六旬聖壽節，上率王、公、大臣詣壽康宮行慶賀禮。

translations.literal: On day yichou, the Empress Dowager's sixtieth sacred birthday: the Emperor led princes, dukes, and ministers to the Palace of Longevity and Health to perform congratulatory rites.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, the Emperor led the court to congratulate the Empress Dowager at Shoukang Palace.

sentences.zh: 上御太和殿，群臣進表行慶賀禮。

translations.literal: The Emperor ascended the Hall of Supreme Harmony; ministers presented memorials and performed congratulatory rites.
translations.idiomatic: At Taihe Hall, ministers presented birthday congratulations.

sentences.zh: 詔天下覃恩有差。

translations.literal: An edict granted differentiated favors throughout the empire.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted empire-wide differentiated favors.

sentences.zh: 以富呢揚阿為烏魯木齊都統。

translations.literal: Funiyang'a was made Urumchi military governor.
translations.idiomatic: Funiyang'a became Urumchi military governor.

sentences.zh: 癸未，御史湯鵬以劾載銓忤旨罷。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Censor Tang Peng was dismissed for impeaching Zaiquan contrary to the imperial will.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Tang Peng was dismissed for impeaching Zaiquan against the throne's will.

sentences.zh: 予告大學士托津卒。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Tuojin, who was on leave, died.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Tuojin died while on leave.

sentences.zh: 是月，給山西陽曲等五州縣、湖南岳州衛、浙江海寧等十三州縣被災口糧。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was issued to disaster victims in five Shanxi prefectures and counties including Yangqu, Yuezhou Guard in Hunan, and thirteen Zhejiang prefectures and counties including Haining.
translations.idiomatic: That month, disaster rations went to Yangqu and four other Shanxi districts, Yuezhou Guard, and Haining and twelve other Zhejiang counties.

sentences.zh: 貸奉天金州水師營兵穀。

translations.literal: Granary grain was loaned to troops of the Fengtian Jinzhou naval camp.
translations.idiomatic: Fengtian's Jinzhou naval camp received a granary grain loan.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩湖南華容等十四州縣衛、浙江海寧等三十一州縣衛被災新舊額賦雜款。

translations.literal: New and old quota levies and miscellaneous items were remitted or deferred for fourteen Hunan prefectures, counties, and guards including Huarong and thirty-one Zhejiang prefectures, counties, and guards including Haining.
translations.idiomatic: Quota and miscellaneous taxes were remitted or deferred for Huarong and thirteen other Hunan districts and Haining and thirty other Zhejiang districts.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊戌，臨大學士托津第賜奠。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuxu: the Emperor visited Grand Secretary Tuojin's residence to bestow funeral gifts.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, wuxu, the Emperor condoled at Tuojin's home with imperial gifts.

sentences.zh: 是月，給吉林等三處歉區口糧。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was issued to poor areas in three places including Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: That month, three poor districts including Jilin received ration grain.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未，上再詣大高殿祈雪。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiwei: the Emperor again went to the Dagao Hall to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, jiwei, the Emperor again prayed for snow at Dagao Hall.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，孝穆皇后、孝慎皇后梓宮奉安地宮。

translations.literal: On day yichou, the coffins of Empress Xiaomu and Empress Xiaoshen were installed in the underground palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Empresses Xiaomu and Xiaoshen were interred in the underground palace.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以樂善為吉林將軍。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Leshan was made Jilin general.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Leshan became Jilin general.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸江蘇撫標及城守、劉河二營災區兵餉。

translations.literal: That month, troop pay was loaned to the Jiangsu provincial standard and the city-garrison and Liuhe river camps in disaster zones.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Jiangsu provincial and garrison troops in disaster zones received pay loans.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩貴州松桃廳被水額賦。

translations.literal: Quota levies for Songtao department in Guizhou were remitted or deferred because of flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Songtao's flood quota taxes were remitted or deferred.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Korea and Ryukyu paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 十六年春正月乙未，以車倫多爾濟為庫倫蒙古辦事大臣。

translations.literal: Year 16, spring, first month, day yiwei: Cherendorji was made commissioner for Urga Mongol affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of year 16, yiwei, Cherendorji became Urga Mongol commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，撥山東司庫銀五萬兩賑登、萊、青三府饑。

translations.literal: On day renyin, fifty thousand taels from the Shandong provincial treasury were allocated to relieve famine in Deng, Lai, and Qing prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, fifty thousand Shandong treasury taels relieved famine in Deng, Lai, and Qing.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，調裕泰為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Yutai was transferred to Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Yutai became Hunan governor.

sentences.zh: 以賀長齡為貴州巡撫。

translations.literal: He Changling was made Guizhou governor.
translations.idiomatic: He Changling became Guizhou governor.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑浙江義烏等三縣水旱災。

translations.literal: That month, relief was given for flood and drought disasters in three Zhejiang counties including Yiwu.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Yiwu and two other Zhejiang counties received flood-and-drought relief.

sentences.zh: 給奉天廣寧等處水災旗民口糧。

translations.literal: Ration grain was issued to banner people in Fengtian districts including Guangning that had suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Flood-hit banner people in Guangning and other Fengtian districts received rations.

sentences.zh: 貸甘肅金州等十四州縣、江西蓮花等五十一廳縣、陝西葭州等九州廳縣、湖南澧州等四州縣、山西保德等十五州縣水旱雹災口糧籽種倉穀。

translations.literal: Ration grain, seed grain, and granary grain were loaned for flood, drought, hail, and other disasters to fourteen Gansu prefectures and counties including Jinzhou, fifty-one Jiangxi departments and counties including Lianhua, nine Shaanxi prefectures and departments including Jiazhou, four Hunan prefectures and counties including Lizhou, and fifteen Shanxi prefectures and counties including Baode.
translations.idiomatic: Disaster loans of rations and seed went to Jinzhou and thirteen other Gansu districts, Lianhua and fifty other Jiangxi districts, Jiazhou and eight other Shaanxi districts, Lizhou and three other Hunan districts, and Baode and fourteen other Shanxi districts.

sentences.zh: 二月丙辰，調周之琦為湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingchen: Zhou Zhiqi was transferred to Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, bingchen, Zhou Zhiqi became Hubei governor.

sentences.zh: 以陳鑾為江西巡撫。

translations.literal: Chen Luan was made Jiangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Luan became Jiangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 己未，以謁東陵，命肅親王等留京辦事。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, for the visit to the Eastern Tombs, Prince Su and others were left in the capital to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Prince Su and others stayed in Beijing for the Eastern Tombs visit.

sentences.zh: 己巳，上閱火器營兵。

translations.literal: On day jisi, the Emperor reviewed troops of the Firearms Camp.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, the Emperor reviewed the Firearms Camp.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，上謁東陵，免經過地方額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs and remitted one-third of quota levies in passed areas.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, the Emperor visited the Eastern Tombs and remitted one-third of passed-area quota tax.

sentences.zh: 丙子，上謁昭西陵、孝陵、孝東陵、景陵、裕陵。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, the Emperor paid rites at the Western Zhao Tombs, Xiaoling, Xiao East Tombs, Jing Tomb, and Yu Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, the Emperor worshipped at the Western Zhao, Xiaoling, Xiao East, Jing, and Yu tombs.

sentences.zh: 湖南武岡州匪藍正樽等作亂，命吳榮光會同訥爾經額剿之。

translations.literal: In Wugong prefecture, Hunan, bandits Lan Zhengzun and others rebelled; Wu Rongguang was ordered to join Ne'erjing'e in suppressing them.
translations.idiomatic: Wugong bandits led by Lan Zhengzun rebelled; Wu Rongguang and Ne'erjing'e were ordered to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，免四川瓘邊廳逋賦。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, arrears at Fanbian department in Sichuan were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, Fanbian department's arrears were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 己卯，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day jimao, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸亥，以梁章钜為廣西巡撫。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guihai: Liang Zhangju was made Guangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, guihai, Liang Zhangju became Guangxi governor.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，賜林鴻年等一百七十二人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Lin Hongnian and one hundred seventy-two others were granted jinshi degrees and metropolitan graduate status with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Lin Hongnian and 172 others received jinshi and metropolitan degrees with distinctions.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸甘肅秦州等八州縣被災口糧。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was loaned to eight Gansu prefectures and counties including Qinzhou that had suffered disasters.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Qinzhou and seven other Gansu districts received disaster ration loans.

sentences.zh: 五月丙申，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingshen: the Emperor went to the Black Dragon Pool to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, bingshen, the Emperor prayed for rain at the Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，禮部尚書汪守和卒，以吳椿為禮部尚書，李宗昉為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Minister of Rites Wang Shouhe died; Wu Chun was made Minister of Rites and Li Zongfang left censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Wang Shouhe died; Wu Chun took Rites and Li Zongfang the Censorate's left chief.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上詣靜明園龍王廟祈雨。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the Emperor went to the Dragon King Temple at Jingming Garden to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, the Emperor prayed for rain at Jingming Garden's Dragon King Temple.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸直隸寶坻縣歉收口糧。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was loaned to poor victims in Baodi county, Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Baodi's poor disaster victims received ration loans.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸未，以鍾祥為閩浙總督，經額布為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guiwei: Zhong Xiang was made Fujian-Zhejiang governor-general and Jinge Bu Shandong governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, guiwei, Zhong Xiang took Fujian-Zhejiang and Jinge Bu Shandong.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以哈豐阿舉發都統高喀鼐干預公事書信，加太子太保。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, because Hafeng'a reported Metropolitan Banner commandant Gao Kanai's interference in official business by letter, Gao was given the added title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Hafeng'a exposed Gao Kanai's interference and Gao received an added Grand Guardian title.

sentences.zh: 己丑，高喀鼐褫職，遣戍熱河。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Gao Kanai was dismissed from office and banished to Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Gao Kanai lost his post and was sent to Rehe.

sentences.zh: 丙申，大學士文孚致仕。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Grand Secretary Wen Fu retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Grand Secretary Wen Fu retired.

sentences.zh: 庚子，命穆彰阿為大學士管工部，琦善協辦大學士，仍留直隸總督任。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Muzhang'a was made grand secretary supervising the Ministry of Works; Qishan was made associate grand secretary while remaining Zhili governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Muzhang'a became grand secretary over Works and Qishan associate grand secretary while staying Zhili governor-general.

sentences.zh: 調耆英為吏部尚書，奕顥為戶部尚書，禧恩為兵部尚書，武忠額為理籓院尚書，凱音布為左都御史，樂善為察哈爾都統。

translations.literal: Qiying was transferred to Minister of Personnel, Yihao to Minister of Revenue, Xi'en to Minister of War, Wuzhong'e to Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs, Kaiyinbu to left censor-in-chief, and Leshan to Chahar commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Qiying took Personnel, Yihao Revenue, Xi'en War, Wuzhong'e colonial affairs, Kaiyinbu the left censorate, and Leshan Chahar.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，恩銘免尚書、都統，趙盛奎免軍機大臣及侍郎。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Enming was dismissed as minister and banner commander; Zhao Shengkui was dismissed as Grand Councilor and vice minister.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Enming lost his minister and command posts and Zhao Shengkui left the Grand Council and a vice ministry.

sentences.zh: 以貴慶為禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Guiqing was made Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Guiqing became Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 九月壬辰，以富呢揚阿為陝西巡撫，廉敬為烏魯木齊都統。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renchen: Funiyang'a was made Shaanxi governor and Lian Jing Urumqi commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, renchen, Funiyang'a took Shaanxi and Lian Jing Urumqi.

sentences.zh: 庚子，上閱健銳營兵。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the Emperor reviewed troops of the Jianrui Camp.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, the Emperor reviewed the Jianrui Camp.

sentences.zh: 戊申，圓明園三殿災。

translations.literal: On day wushen, three halls of the Old Summer Palace burned.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, three Old Summer Palace halls burned.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以耆英受太監屬託，褫尚書、都統、內務府大臣。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, because Qiying had accepted a eunuch's entrustment, he was stripped of his posts as minister, banner commander, and Grand Minister of the Imperial Household.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Qiying lost his minister, command, and household posts for taking a eunuch's entrustment.

sentences.zh: 以奕經為吏部尚書，寶興為盛京將軍。

translations.literal: Yi Jing was made Minister of Personnel and Baoxing Shengjing general.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Jing took Personnel and Baoxing became Shengjing general.

sentences.zh: 左都御史凱音布遷成都將軍，以敬徵代之。

translations.literal: Left Censor-in-Chief Kaiyinbu was transferred to Chengdu general and Jingzheng replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Kaiyinbu went to Chengdu and Jingzheng took the left censorate.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑盛京白旗堡等處、山西朔州等十一州廳縣、貴州松桃廳災民。

translations.literal: That month, disaster victims were relieved in White Banner Fort and other places in Shengjing, eleven Shanxi prefectures and departments including Shuozhou, and Songtao department in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Shengjing, Shuozhou and ten other Shanxi districts, and Songtao received disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 展賑陝西神木縣災民。

translations.literal: Relief for disaster victims in Shenmu county, Shaanxi, was extended.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi's Shenmu disaster relief was extended.

sentences.zh: 蠲免山西朔州等十一州廳縣、陝西榆林府屬被災新舊額賦。

translations.literal: New and old quota levies were remitted for eleven Shanxi prefectures and departments including Shuozhou and subjects of Yulin prefecture in Shaanxi that had suffered disasters.
translations.idiomatic: Disaster quota taxes were remitted for Shuozhou and ten other Shanxi districts and Yulin subordinates in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙辰，加長清太子太保。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingchen: Changqing was given the added title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, bingchen, Changqing received an added Grand Guardian title.

sentences.zh: 貸甘肅涇州等八州縣、山西山陰縣災歉口糧倉穀籽種。

translations.literal: Ration grain, granary grain, and seed grain were loaned to eight Gansu prefectures and counties including Jingzhou and to Shanyin county, Shanxi, for disaster and poor harvest.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhou and seven other Gansu districts and Shanyin received disaster loans of rations and seed.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩直隸景州等十二州縣水旱災新舊額賦。

translations.literal: New and old quota levies for flood and drought disasters were remitted or deferred in twelve Zhili prefectures and counties including Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Flood-and-drought quota taxes were remitted or deferred for Jingzhou and eleven other Zhili districts.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬午，以敬徵為工部尚書，調武忠額為左都御史，以奕紀為理籓院尚書。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renwu: Jingzheng was made Minister of Works; Wuzhong'e was transferred to left censor-in-chief; Yi Ji was made Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, renwu, Jingzheng took Works, Wuzhong'e the left censorate, and Yi Ji colonial affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上詣大高殿祈雪。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Emperor went to the Dagao Hall to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, the Emperor prayed for snow at Dagao Hall.

sentences.zh: 是月，給陝西府穀等四縣霜雹災口糧。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was issued for frost and hail disasters in four Shaanxi counties including Fugu.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Fugu and three other Shaanxi counties received frost-and-hail rations.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩直隸安州等三州縣水災額賦。

translations.literal: Quota levies were remitted or deferred for three Zhili prefectures and counties including Anzhou that had suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Flood quota taxes were remitted or deferred for Anzhou and two other Zhili districts.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳，上再詣大高殿祈雪。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingyou: the Emperor again went to the Dagao Hall to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, dingyou, the Emperor again prayed for snow at Dagao Hall.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，雪。

translations.literal: On day guihai, it snowed.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, snow fell.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮、暹羅來貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea and Siam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Korea and Siam paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 十七年春正月己卯朔，命奕紀為御前大臣。

translations.literal: Year 17, spring, first month, new moon on day jimao: Yi Ji was made imperial front minister.
translations.idiomatic: At the year-17 spring new moon, jimao, Yi Ji became imperial front minister.

sentences.zh: 賞長齡四開褉袍。

translations.literal: Changqing was rewarded with a four-open python robe.
translations.idiomatic: Changqing received a four-open python robe.

sentences.zh: 加潘世恩太子太保。

translations.literal: Pan Shien was given the added title Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Shien received an added Grand Guardian title.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，兵部尚書王宗誠卒，以朱士彥代之。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Minister of War Wang Zongcheng died; Zhu Shiyan replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day, Wang Zongcheng died and Zhu Shiyan took War.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，山東濰縣教匪馬剛等作亂，捕獲之。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, in Weixian, Shandong, teaching-sect rebels Ma Gang and others rose; they were captured.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Weixian teaching rebels led by Ma Gang were captured.

sentences.zh: 庚子，降訥爾經額湖南巡撫，以林則徐為湖廣總督，調陳鑾為江蘇巡撫，裕泰為江西巡撫。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Ne'erjing'e was demoted from Hunan governor; Lin Zexu was made Huguang governor-general; Chen Luan was transferred to Jiangsu governor and Yutai to Jiangxi governor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, Ne'erjing'e lost Hunan, Lin Zexu took Huguang, Chen Luan Jiangsu, and Yutai Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸山西朔州等十一州廳縣、陝西葭州等九州縣、甘肅金州等十三州縣水災旱災蝗災雹災霜災倉穀口糧籽種。

translations.literal: That month, granary grain, ration grain, and seed grain were loaned for flood, drought, locust, hail, and frost disasters to eleven Shanxi prefectures and departments including Shuozhou, nine Shaanxi prefectures and counties including Jiazhou, and thirteen Gansu prefectures and counties including Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Shuozhou and ten other Shanxi districts, Jiazhou and eight other Shaanxi districts, and Jinzhou and twelve other Gansu districts received disaster grain loans.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，福建嘉義縣教匪沈知等作亂，捕誅之。

translations.literal: Second month, day yimao: in Jiayi county, Fujian, teaching-sect rebels Shen Zhi and others rose; they were captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, yimao, Jiayi teaching rebels led by Shen Zhi were captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸山西吉州等七州縣倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, granary grain was loaned to seven Shanxi prefectures and counties including Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Jizhou and six other Shanxi districts received granary loans.

sentences.zh: 三月戊寅朔，以詣棽髻山，命惇親王綿愷等留京辦事。

translations.literal: Third month, new moon on day wuyin: for the visit to Cenqi Mountain, Prince Dun Miankai and others were left in the capital to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: At the third-month new moon, wuyin, Prince Dun and others stayed in Beijing for the Cenqi Mountain visit.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，上奉皇太后幸棽髻山，免經過地方本年額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, went to Cenqi Mountain and remitted one-third of this year's quota levies in passed areas.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to Cenqi Mountain and remitted one-third of this year's passed-area quota tax.

sentences.zh: 甲午，上奉皇太后還圓明園。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager back to the Old Summer Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, the Empress Dowager returned to the Old Summer Palace.

sentences.zh: 以耆英為熱河都統。

translations.literal: Qiying was made Rehe military governor.
translations.idiomatic: Qiying became Rehe military governor.

sentences.zh: 乙未，上詣明陵。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, the Emperor visited the Ming tombs.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, the Emperor visited the Ming tombs.

sentences.zh: 丙申，上詣明長陵、獻陵、泰陵、景陵、永陵奠酒。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, the Emperor offered libations at the Ming Chang Tomb, Xian Tomb, Tai Tomb, Jing Tomb, and Yong Tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, the Emperor offered libations at Ming Changling, Xianling, Tailing, Jingling, and Yongling.

sentences.zh: 以明裔延恩侯書桂為散秩大臣。

translations.literal: Shu Gui, Marquis of Extended Grace and Ming descendant, was made honorary minister.
translations.idiomatic: Ming descendant Shu Gui, Marquis of Extended Grace, became honorary minister.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，上還圓明園。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, the Emperor returned to the Old Summer Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, the Emperor returned to the Old Summer Palace.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚申，命彥德鞫治茂明安署劄薩克貝勒丹丕勒等訐控盟長之獄。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengshen: Yande was ordered to try the case in which Maoming'an acting jasaq prince Danpengle and others accused their league chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, gengshen, Yande was ordered to try Danpengle's accusation against his Maoming'an league chief.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以顏伯燾為雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Yan Bozao was made Yunnan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Yan Bozao became Yunnan governor.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸山東濮州等二十四州縣衛、山西寧武縣倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, granary grain was loaned to twenty-four Shandong prefectures, counties, and guards including Puzhou and to Ningwu county, Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Puzhou and twenty-three other Shandong districts and Ningwu received granary loans.

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅，貴慶病免，調奕紀為禮部尚書，以武忠額為理籓院尚書，奎照為左都御史。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuyin: Guiqing was dismissed because of illness; Yi Ji was transferred to Minister of Rites; Wuzhong'e was made Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs; Kuizhao was made left censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, wuyin, Guiqing fell ill and left office; Yi Ji took Rites, Wuzhong'e colonial affairs, and Kuizhao the left censorate.

sentences.zh: 以周天爵署漕運總督。

translations.literal: Zhou Tianjue acted as grain-transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Tianjue acted as grain-transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，以御史朱成烈奏廣東海口每歲出銀三千餘萬，福建、浙江、江蘇各海口出銀不下千萬，天津海口出銀亦二千餘萬，命沿海各督撫及各監督嚴飭稽查。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day gengxu: on Censor Zhu Chengylie's memorial that each year Guangdong's ports disbursed more than thirty million taels of silver, that ports in Fujian, Zhejiang, and Jiangsu each disbursed no less than ten million, and that Tianjin's ports also disbursed more than twenty million, the coastal governors-general, governors, and supervisors were ordered to investigate strictly.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, gengxu, Zhu Chengylie's memorial on massive coastal silver outflows ordered strict investigation by coastal governors and supervisors.

sentences.zh: 戊午，命左都御史奎照、戶部侍郎文慶在軍機大臣上學習行走。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Left Censor-in-Chief Kuizhao and Vice Minister of Revenue Wen Qing were ordered to study while serving on the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Kuizhao and Wen Qing were ordered to learn Grand Council duties.

sentences.zh: 己未，命琦善署直隸總督。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, Qishan was ordered to act as Zhili governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day, Qishan was ordered to act as Zhili governor-general.

sentences.zh: 壬申，四川馬邊廳夷匪作亂，命鄂山剿之。

translations.literal: On day renshen, Yi bandits in Mabian department, Sichuan, rebelled; Eshan was ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day, Mabian Yi rebels rose and Eshan was ordered to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，奕山等奏獲霍罕賊目阿達那等誅之。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Yi Shan and others memorialized that Kokand rebel leaders Adana and others had been captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, Yi Shan reported capturing and executing Kokand rebel leader Adana and others.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸江蘇淮安、大河二衛被災籽種。

translations.literal: That month, seed grain was loaned to Huai'an and Dahe guards in Jiangsu that had suffered disasters.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Jiangsu's Huai'an and Dahe guards received disaster seed loans.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙子朔，命侍郎倭什納等冊封朝鮮王妃。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, new moon on day bingzi: Vice Minister Woshina and others were ordered to invest the queen of Korea.
translations.idiomatic: At the seventh-month new moon, bingzi, Woshina and others were sent to invest Korea's queen.

sentences.zh: 壬午，樂善遷荊州將軍，以賽尚阿為察哈爾都統。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Leshan was transferred to Jingzhou general and Saishang'a was made Chahar commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Leshan went to Jingzhou and Saishang'a took Chahar.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，諭栗毓美，東河磚工改辦碎石。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Li Yumei was instructed that the East River brick works were to be changed to stone.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Li Yumei was told to replace East River brick works with stone.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，西寧辦事大臣德楞額遷荊州將軍，以蘇勒芳阿代之。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Xining commissioner Delenge was transferred to Jingzhou general and Sulefang'a replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, Delenge went to Jingzhou and Sulefang'a took Xining.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，廓爾喀年貢逾例，溫諭卻之。

translations.literal: On day jiaxu, Nepal's annual tribute exceeded the norm; it was gently declined.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, excessive Nepalese tribute was gently refused.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅，授周天爵漕運總督。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengyin: Zhou Tianjue was appointed grain-transport governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, gengyin, Zhou Tianjue became grain-transport governor-general.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，召訥爾經額來京。

translations.literal: On day guisi, Ne'erjing'e was summoned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, Ne'erjing'e was called to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以錢寶琛為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, Qian Baochen was made Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Qian Baochen became Hunan governor.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，免直隸邢臺、阜城二縣被旱額賦十分之五。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, five-tenths of drought quota levies were remitted for Xingtai and Fucheng counties in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, half of Xingtai and Fucheng's drought quota tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙午，上臨大學士長齡第視疾。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingwu: the Emperor visited Grand Secretary Changqing's residence to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, bingwu, the Emperor visited Changqing at home to inquire after his illness.

sentences.zh: 辛未，停吉林珠貢。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Jilin pearl tribute was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Jilin pearl tribute was halted.

sentences.zh: 是月，給陝西保安縣被災籽種口糧，並貸綏德等四州縣倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, seed grain and ration grain were issued to disaster victims in Bao'an, Shaanxi, and granary grain was loaned to four prefectures and counties including Suide.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Bao'an received disaster seed and rations and Suide and three other districts received granary loans.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩山西應州等十州縣、齊齊哈爾等三城被災新舊額賦。

translations.literal: Old and new quota levies were remitted or deferred for ten Shanxi prefectures and counties including Yingzhou and three cities including Qiqihar that suffered disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Old and new quotas were remitted or deferred for Yingzhou and nine other Shanxi units and three Qiqihar cities.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛卯，晉封長齡一等威勇公。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day xinmao: Chang Ling was advanced to first-rank Marquis of Weiyong.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, xinmao, Chang Ling was made first-rank Marquis of Weiyong.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸甘肅金州等九州縣貧民、江西南昌等十三縣、陝西葭州等五州縣被災籽種口糧倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, seed grain and ration grain from granaries were loaned to the poor in nine Gansu prefectures and counties including Jinzhou, thirteen Jiangxi counties including Nanchang, and five Shaanxi prefectures and counties including Jiazhou that suffered disaster.
translations.idiomatic: That month, disaster seed and granary rations were loaned across Gansu, Jiangxi, and Shaanxi districts.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁未，涼山夷匪平。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day dingwei: Liangshan Yi bandits were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, dingwei, Liangshan Yi rebels were pacified.

sentences.zh: 己巳，李宗昉憂免，以卓秉恬為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Li Zongfang left office on bereavement and Zhuo Bingtian was made Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Li Zongfang mourned out and Zhuo Bingtian became left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 庚午，彥德以年老留京，以棍楚克策楞為綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, Yande was kept in the capital on account of age and Gunchukeceleng was made Suiyuan City general.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day, Yande stayed in Beijing for age and Gunchukeceleng became Suiyuan City general.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸陝西定邊、安定二縣來春口糧籽種。

translations.literal: That month, next spring's ration grain and seed grain were loaned to Dingbian and Anding, Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Dingbian and Anding received spring ration and seed loans.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮、琉球、暹羅、越南來貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea, Ryukyu, Siam, and Vietnam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Korea, Ryukyu, Siam, and Vietnam paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 十八年春正月甲戌朔，命奎照、文慶為軍機大臣。

translations.literal: Eighteenth year, first month, new moon on day jiaxu: Kuizhao and Wenqing were made Grand Councilors.
translations.idiomatic: In year 18, month 1, jiaxu new moon, Kuizhao and Wenqing joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，太傅、大學士、一等公長齡卒。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Grand Tutor, Grand Secretary, and first-rank Duke Chang Ling died.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, Grand Tutor and Grand Secretary Chang Ling died.

sentences.zh: 丙子，上臨長齡第賜奠。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, the Emperor visited Chang Ling's residence to grant mourning gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, the Emperor mourned at Chang Ling's house.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，四川夷匪平。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Sichuan Yi bandits were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Sichuan Yi rebels were pacified.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸甘肅固原等十四州廳縣、山西平定等五州縣災民口糧籽種倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain, seed grain, and granary grain were loaned to disaster victims in fourteen Gansu prefectures, departments, and counties including Guyuan and five Shanxi prefectures and counties including Pingding.
translations.idiomatic: That month, disaster relief grain was loaned across Guyuan and other Gansu units and Pingding and four other Shanxi units.

sentences.zh: 二月癸卯朔，命琦善為大學士，仍署直隸總督。

translations.literal: Second month, new moon on day guimao: Qishan was made Grand Secretary while continuing to act as Zhili governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, guimao new moon, Qishan became grand secretary and still acted Zhili governor-general.

sentences.zh: 以雲貴總督伊-{里}-布協辦大學士，仍留任。

translations.literal: Yunnan-Guizhou Governor-General Yilibu was made associate Grand Secretary while remaining in office.
translations.idiomatic: Yilibu became associate grand secretary and kept his Yunnan-Guizhou post.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，史致儼病免，以祁為刑部尚書，怡良為廣東巡撫。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Shi Zhiyan left office on illness and Qi was made Minister of Justice, Yiliang Guangdong governor.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Shi Zhiyan retired ill; Qi took justice and Yiliang took Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，修喀喇沙爾城。

translations.literal: On day renxu, Karashahr city was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, Karashahr city was repaired.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，修浙江海塘。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Zhejiang sea dikes were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Zhejiang sea dikes were repaired.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸陝西懷遠、府穀二縣歉收籽種。

translations.literal: That month, seed grain was loaned for poor harvest in Huaiyuan and Fugu, Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Huaiyuan and Fugu received poor-harvest seed loans.

sentences.zh: 三月乙亥，以謁陵命肅親王等留京辦事。

translations.literal: Third month, day yihai: for the tomb visit, Prince Su and others were left in the capital to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai in month 3, Prince Su and others stayed in Beijing for the tomb visit.

sentences.zh: 戊子，上奉皇太后謁西陵，免經過地方額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, paid rites at the Western Tombs; one-third of quota levies in passed areas was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, the Emperor escorted the Empress Dowager to the Western Tombs and remitted one-third of passed-area quota tax.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，上謁泰陵、泰東陵、昌陵，詣孝穆皇后、孝慎皇后陵寢奠酒。

translations.literal: The Emperor paid rites at Tai Tomb, Tai East Tomb, and Chang Tomb and offered wine at the mausolea of Empresses Xiaomu and Xiaoshen.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor worshipped at Tai, Tai East, and Chang tombs and made offerings at Xiaomu and Xiaoshen.

sentences.zh: 乙未，上奉皇太后還京師。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, the Emperor, escorting the Empress Dowager, returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, the Emperor and Empress Dowager returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 丙申，上幸南苑行圍，至戊戌皆如之。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, the Emperor visited the Southern Park for the battue; on days wuxu and jiwei he did the same.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day the Emperor hunted at the Southern Park, and again on wuxu and jiwei.

sentences.zh: 庚子，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，噶勒丹錫埒圖薩瑪第巴克什入貢。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Galedanxielietu Samadibakshi presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Galedanxielietu Samadibakshi paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸山西遼州等十三州廳縣上年歉收倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, granary grain was loaned for last year's poor harvest in thirteen Shanxi prefectures, departments, and counties including Liaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Liaozhou and twelve other Shanxi units received loans for last year's poor harvest.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚申，以富呢揚阿等建乌魯木齊書院，議處有差。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengshen: because Funiyang'a and others built an academy at Urumqi, they were punished to varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4, gengshen, Funiyang'a and others were punished for building an Urumqi academy.

sentences.zh: 申命新疆將軍、都統、大臣認真教練，使人人習于戰陣、毋舍實政務虛名。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Xinjiang generals, commandants, and grand ministers to drill troops earnestly so that all would be practiced in battle array and not abandon substantive duties for empty reputation.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Xinjiang commanders to drill troops in earnest and not chase empty reputation over real duty.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以伍長華為湖北巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Wu Changhua was made Hubei governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day, Wu Changhua became Hubei governor.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，賜鈕福保等一百九十四人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Niu Fubao and one hundred ninety-four others were granted jinshi degrees and metropolitan graduate ranks in varying grades.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Niu Fubao and 194 others received jinshi and metropolitan ranks.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以奕出為伊犁將軍，湍多布為伊犁參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Yichu was made Ili general and Tuanduobu Ili assistant commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Yichu became Ili general and Tuanduobu Ili assistant commissioner.

sentences.zh: 閏四月丙子，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: Intercalary fourth month, day bingzi: the Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.
translations.idiomatic: In intercalary month 4, bingzi, the Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，雨。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, rain fell.

sentences.zh: 鴻臚寺卿黃爵滋奏請將內地吸食鴉片者俱罪死。

translations.literal: Honglu Temple Director Huang Juezi memorialized that all who smoked opium within the interior should be punished with death.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Juezi urged the death penalty for inland opium smokers.

sentences.zh: 命盛京、吉林、黑龍江將軍，直省督撫各抒所見議奏。

translations.literal: The generals of Fengtian, Jilin, and Heilongjiang and the governors-general and governors of the provinces were ordered each to set forth his views in memorials.
translations.idiomatic: Fengtian, Jilin, and Heilongjiang generals and provincial governors were ordered to submit opinions.

sentences.zh: 己丑，褫禧恩太子太保銜兵部尚書，調成格為兵部尚書，以鄂山為刑部尚書，寶興為四川總督，耆英為盛京將軍，惠吉為熱河都統。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Xi'en was stripped of Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent rank and the Ministry of War post; Chengge was transferred to Minister of War; Eshan was made Minister of Justice; Baoxing Sichuan governor-general; Qiying Fengtian general; Huiji Rehe commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Xi'en lost Grand Guardian and war minister posts; Chengge, Eshan, Baoxing, Qiying, and Huiji were reassigned.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，調奕紀為戶部尚書，成格為禮部尚書，奕顥為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, Yiji was transferred to Minister of Revenue, Chengge to Minister of Rites, and Yihou Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, Yiji took revenue, Chengge rites, and Yihou war.

sentences.zh: 五月丙午，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day bingwu: the Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.
translations.idiomatic: In month 5, bingwu, the Emperor again prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 己酉，雨。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, rain fell.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，大學士阮元致仕。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Grand Secretary Ruan Yuan retired.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Grand Secretary Ruan Yuan retired.

sentences.zh: 命王鼎為大學士，仍管刑部，湯金釗為戶部尚書、協辦大學士，朱士彥為吏部尚書，卓秉恬為兵部尚書，姚元之為左都御史。

translations.literal: Wang Ding was made Grand Secretary while continuing to oversee the Ministry of Justice; Tang Jinzhang Minister of Revenue and associate Grand Secretary; Zhu Shiyan Minister of Personnel; Zhuo Bingtian Minister of War; Yao Yuanzhi Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ding became grand secretary over justice; Tang Jinzhang revenue and associate grand secretary; Zhu Shiyan personnel; Zhuo Bingtian war; Yao Yuanzhi left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，惇親王綿愷免內廷行走、宗令，罰親王俸三年。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Prince Dun Min Kai was removed from inner-court attendance and the post of clan prince, and deprived of three years' princely stipend.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Prince Dun Min Kai lost inner-court and clan-prince duties and forfeited three years' stipend.

sentences.zh: 六月辛未，免四川馬邊、雷波二廳逋賦及各廠應解銅鉛。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinwei: overdue levies and copper and lead due from factories were remitted for Mabian and Leibo departments, Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In month 6, xinwei, Mabian and Leibo had overdue levies and factory dues remitted.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，降惇親王綿愷為郡王。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Prince Dun Min Kai was reduced to commandery prince.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Prince Dun Min Kai was demoted to commandery prince.

sentences.zh: 己卯，命湍多布為塔爾巴哈台參贊大臣，關福為伊犁參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Tuanduobu was made Tarbagatai assistant commissioner and Guanfu Ili assistant commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Tuanduobu became Tarbagatai assistant commissioner and Guanfu Ili assistant commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是月，給貴州鎮遠府屬被水兵民口糧。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was issued to soldiers and civilians under Zhenyuan prefecture, Guizhou, who suffered flood.
translations.idiomatic: That month, flood rations went to Zhenyuan prefecture troops and people.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊申，刑部尚書鄂山卒，以寶興為刑部尚書，蘇廷玉署四川總督。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wushen: Minister of Justice Eshan died; Baoxing was made Minister of Justice and Su Tingyu acted Sichuan governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: In month 7, wushen, Eshan died; Baoxing took justice and Su Tingyu acted Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 八月丙戌，以林則徐等奏查獲煙販收繳煙具情形，諭嘉之。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingxu: because Lin Zexu and others memorialized on seized opium traffickers and confiscated smoking paraphernalia, an edict praised them.
translations.idiomatic: In month 8, bingxu, the court praised Lin Zexu's report on seized traffickers and confiscated opium gear.

sentences.zh: 己丑，成格免，以奎照為禮部尚書，恩銘為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day jichou, Chengge left office; Kuizhao was made Minister of Rites and Enming Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, Chengge left office; Kuizhao took rites and Enming became left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 命奕紀管理籓院。

translations.literal: Yiji was ordered to oversee the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yiji was placed over the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 以賽尚阿署理籓院尚書，布彥泰為察哈爾都統。

translations.literal: Saishang'a acted Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs and Buyantai Chahar commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Saishang'a acted colonial minister and Buyantai became Chahar commandant.

sentences.zh: 是月，給陝西安定、府谷二縣災民口糧。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was issued to disaster victims in Anding and Fugu, Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Anding and Fugu received disaster rations.

sentences.zh: 九月丙午，莊親王奕鎛等坐食鴉片革爵。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingwu: Prince Zhuang Yi Bo and others were stripped of rank for smoking opium.
translations.idiomatic: In month 9, bingwu, Prince Zhuang Yi Bo and others lost rank for opium use.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上閱健銳營兵。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the Emperor reviewed the Jianrui Camp troops.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day, the Emperor reviewed Jianrui Camp troops.

sentences.zh: 己酉，太常寺少卿許乃濟請弛鴉片禁，命休致。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Xu Naiji asked that the opium prohibition be relaxed and was ordered to retire.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Xu Naiji urged relaxing the opium ban and was retired.

sentences.zh: 召林則徐來京，以伍長華署湖廣總督。

translations.literal: Lin Zexu was summoned to the capital and Wu Changhua acted Huguang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Zexu was called to Beijing and Wu Changhua acted Huguang.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，調錢寶琛為江西巡撫，裕泰為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Qian Baochen was transferred to Jiangxi governor and Yutai Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day, Qian Baochen went to Jiangxi and Yutai to Hunan.

sentences.zh: 吏部尚書朱士彥卒，調湯金釗為吏部尚書，吳椿為戶部尚書，以龔守正署禮部尚書。

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel Zhu Shiyan died; Tang Jinzhang was transferred to Minister of Personnel, Wu Chun Minister of Revenue, and Gong Shouzheng acted Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Shiyan died; Tang Jinzhang took personnel, Wu Chun revenue, and Gong Shouzheng acted rites.

sentences.zh: 是月，給山東濰縣災民口糧。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was issued to disaster victims in Weixian, Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Weixian received disaster rations.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚寅，以盛貴為烏-{里}-雅蘇台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengyin: Sheng Gui was made Uliassutai assistant commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10, gengyin, Sheng Gui became Uliassutai assistant commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是月，蠲緩直隸深州等十三州縣、江西南昌等二十二縣、安徽壽州等三十四州縣衛、河南內黃等十一縣、湖南澧州等八州縣衛、奉天寧遠州被災新舊額賦。

translations.literal: That month, old and new quota levies were remitted or deferred for thirteen Zhili prefectures and counties including Shenzhou, twenty-two Jiangxi counties including Nanchang, thirty-four Anhui prefectures, counties, guards, and banners including Shouzhou, eleven Henan counties including Neihuang, eight Hunan prefectures, counties, and guards including Lizhou, and Fengtian's Ningyuan prefecture that suffered disaster.
translations.idiomatic: That month, disaster quotas were remitted or deferred across Zhili, Jiangxi, Anhui, Henan, Hunan, and Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅，命伊-{里}-布等查禁雲南種罌粟。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renyin: Yilibu and others were ordered to investigate and ban opium-poppy cultivation in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, renyin, Yilibu and others were ordered to ban Yunnan poppy growing.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以寶興為四川總督，恩銘為刑部尚書，裕誠為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Baoxing was made Sichuan governor-general, Enming Minister of Justice, and Yucheng Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Baoxing took Sichuan, Enming justice, and Yucheng became left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，命林則徐為欽差大臣，查辦廣東海口事件，節制該省水師。

translations.literal: On day guichou, Lin Zexu was made Imperial Commissioner to investigate the Guangdong port affair and to command that province's naval forces.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Lin Zexu became Imperial Commissioner for Guangdong ports and commanded its fleet.

sentences.zh: 以周天爵署湖廣總督，鐵麟署漕運總督。

translations.literal: Zhou Tianjue acted Huguang governor-general and Tielin acted Grand Canal director-general.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Tianjue acted Huguang and Tielin acted Grand Canal transport.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，上詣大高殿祈雪。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, the Emperor prayed for snow at the Dagao Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, the Emperor prayed for snow at Dagao Hall.

sentences.zh: 以固慶為科布多參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Guqing was made Kobdo assistant commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Guqing became Kobdo assistant commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，兵部尚書奕顥褫職，調裕誠為兵部尚書，以隆文為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Minister of War Yihou was stripped of office; Yucheng was transferred to Minister of War and Longwen Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, Yihou was dismissed; Yucheng took war and Longwen became left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，召哈豐阿來京，以舒倫保署黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, Hafeng'a was summoned to the capital and Shulunbao acted Heilongjiang general.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, Hafeng'a was called to Beijing and Shulunbao acted Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑陝西懷遠、安定二縣，甯古塔三姓地方兵民口糧。

translations.literal: That month, relief grain was given to Huaiyuan and Anding, Shaanxi, and to soldiers and civilians in the Ningguta Sanxing region.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Huaiyuan, Anding, and Ningguta Sanxing received relief rations.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊辰朔，貴州仁懷縣匪謝法真等作亂，命伊-{里}-布剿之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, new moon on day wuchen: bandits including Xie Fazhen of Renhuai county, Guizhou, rose in revolt, and Yilibu was ordered to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: At the twelfth-month new moon, wuchen, Renhuai rebels led by Xie Fazhen rose and Yilibu was ordered to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 辛未，惇郡王綿愷卒，追復親王爵。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, Commandery Prince Dun Min Kai died and was posthumously restored to princely rank.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day, Commandery Prince Dun Min Kai died and was posthumously restored as prince.

sentences.zh: 上親臨其喪三次賜奠。

translations.literal: The Emperor personally attended his mourning three times to grant offerings.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor thrice mourned at his funeral in person.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，上再詣大高殿祈雪。

translations.literal: On day yihai, the Emperor again prayed for snow at the Dagao Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, the Emperor again prayed for snow at Dagao Hall.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，上復詣大高殿祈雪。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, the Emperor again prayed for snow at the Dagao Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, the Emperor prayed for snow at Dagao Hall again.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，移庫倫幫辦大臣駐科布多，為科布多幫辦大臣。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the Urga assisting commissioner stationed at Kobdo was redesignated Kobdo assisting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day, the Urga assisting post at Kobdo became the Kobdo assisting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，授賽尚阿理籓院尚書。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Saishang'a was appointed Minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Saishang'a became colonial minister.

sentences.zh: 乙未，左都御史姚元之免，以龔守正代之。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Left Censor-in-Chief Yao Yuanzhi left office and Gong Shouzheng replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Yao Yuanzhi left office and Gong Shouzheng replaced him.

sentences.zh: 以匪亂平，賞伊-{里}-布雙眼花翎，晉余步雲太子太保。

translations.literal: Because the bandit disturbance was pacified, Yilibu was awarded the double-eyed peacock feather and Yu Buyun was advanced to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: With the rebels pacified, Yilibu received the double-eyed peacock feather and Yu Buyun became Junior Guardian.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮、琉球、暹羅來貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea, Ryukyu, and Siam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Korea, Ryukyu, and Siam paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 十九年春正月戊戌朔，晉封惠郡王釂愉為親王。

translations.literal: Nineteenth year, first month, new moon on day wuxu: Commandery Prince of Hui Min Yu was advanced to prince.
translations.idiomatic: In year 19, month 1, wuxu new moon, Commandery Prince Min Yu became prince.

sentences.zh: 戊午，召奕山來京，以關福署伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: On day wuwu, Yishan was summoned to the capital and Guanfu acted Ili general.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day, Yishan was called to Beijing and Guanfu acted Ili.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸湖南武陵縣、陝西葭州等九州縣、甘肅固原等五州縣水旱災雹災口糧籽種。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain and seed grain were loaned for flood, drought, and hail disasters in Wuling county, Hunan, nine Shaanxi prefectures and counties including Jiazhou, and five Gansu prefectures and counties including Guyuan.
translations.idiomatic: That month, disaster rations and seed were loaned in Wuling, Jiazhou, and Guyuan districts.

sentences.zh: 二月壬午，御試翰林、詹事等官，擢李國杞四員為一等，餘陞黜有差。

translations.literal: Second month, day renwu: the palace examination of Hanlin and Household officials was held; Li Guoqi and three others were raised to first class and the rest were promoted or demoted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In month 2, renwu, the palace exam was held; Li Guoqi and three others took first rank.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以謁東陵，命肅親王敬敏等留京辦事。

translations.literal: On day bingxu, for the Eastern Tombs visit, Prince Su Jingmin and others were left in the capital to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, Prince Su Jingmin and others stayed in Beijing for the Eastern Tombs visit.

sentences.zh: 命林則徐赴虎門、澳門，防外海洋船進口及內匪出洋。

translations.literal: Lin Zexu was ordered to proceed to Humen and Macao to guard against foreign ships entering port and domestic criminals going to sea.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Zexu was sent to Humen and Macao to block foreign entry and domestic smuggling at sea.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子，上謁東陵，免經過地方額賦十分之三。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengzi: the Emperor paid rites at the Eastern Tombs; one-third of quota levies in passed areas was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In month 3, gengzi, the Emperor worshipped at the Eastern Tombs and remitted one-third of passed-area quota tax.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，吳椿病免，調何淩漢為戶部尚書，以陳官俊為工部尚書，龔守正為禮部尚書，廖鴻荃為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Wu Chun left office on illness; He Linghan was transferred to Minister of Revenue; Chen Guanjun Minister of Works; Gong Shouzheng Minister of Rites; Liao Hongquan Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, Wu Chun retired ill; He Linghan took revenue; Chen Guanjun works; Gong Shouzheng rites; Liao Hongquan left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上謁昭西陵、孝陵、孝東陵、景陵、裕陵，詣端慧太子園寢奠酒。

translations.literal: On day guimao, the Emperor paid rites at Zhaoxi Tomb, Xiao Tomb, Xiao East Tomb, Jing Tomb, and Yu Tomb and offered wine at the mausoleum of the Crown Prince Duanhui.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, the Emperor worshipped at Zhaoxi, Xiao, Xiao East, Jing, and Yu tombs and made offerings at Crown Prince Duanhui.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，陶澍病免，調林則徐為兩江總督，以陳鑾署之，裕謙署江蘇巡撫，以桂良為湖廣總督，朱樹為河南巡撫。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Tao Zhu left office on illness; Lin Zexu was transferred to Liangjiang governor-general, Chen Luan acting, Yu Qian acting Jiangsu governor, Gui Liang Huguang governor-general, and Zhu Shu Henan governor.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day, Tao Zhu retired; Lin Zexu took Liangjiang with Chen Luan acting, Yu Qian Jiangsu, Gui Liang Huguang, and Zhu Shu Henan.

sentences.zh: 丙午，上幸南苑行圍。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the Emperor visited the Southern Park for the battue.
