translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, the Emperor hunted at the Southern Park.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，林則徐等奏躉船呈繳煙土，諭嘉之，予獎敘。

translations.literal: On day yimao, because Lin Zexu and others memorialized that receiving ships had presented opium for surrender, an edict praised them and granted rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, the court praised Lin Zexu for surrendered opium from receiving ships and granted rewards.

sentences.zh: 准林則徐等奏，暫緩議斷互市。

translations.literal: Lin Zexu and others were approved in memorializing to defer for the time being deliberation on cutting off mutual trade.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved Lin Zexu's request to postpone cutting off foreign trade.

sentences.zh: 烏魯木齊都統廉敬遷成都將軍，以惠吉代之，以恩銘為熱河都統，隆文為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: Urumqi commandant Lian Jing was transferred to Chengdu general, Huiji replacing him; Enming Rehe commandant; Longwen Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: Lian Jing left Urumqi for Chengdu; Huiji replaced him; Enming took Rehe and Longwen justice.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以鐵麟為左都御史。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Tielin was made Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Tielin became left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛未，以吳文鎔為福建巡撫。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinwei: Wu Wenrong was made Fujian governor.
translations.idiomatic: In month 4, xinwei, Wu Wenrong became Fujian governor.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，調周天爵為河南巡撫，朱樹為漕運總督。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Zhou Tianjue was transferred to be governor of Henan; Zhu Shu was made Grand Canal transport governor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Zhou Tianjue became Henan governor and Zhu Shu canal transport governor.

sentences.zh: 戊子，上詣萬壽山殿祈雨。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, the Emperor went to the Wanshou Mountain Hall to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, the Emperor prayed for rain at Wanshou Mountain Hall.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以直隸旱，免奉天、山東、河南來直米稅。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, because of drought in Zhili, grain transport taxes on rice coming from Fengtian, Shandong, and Henan to Zhili were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Zhili drought brought remission of rice transport taxes from Fengtian, Shandong, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 五月辛丑，雨。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinchou: it rained.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on xinchou day, rain fell.

sentences.zh: 予告大學士盧廕溥卒。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary on leave Lu Yinpu died.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Yinpu, grand secretary on leave, died.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑雲南浪穹、鄧川二州縣地震災額賦。

translations.literal: That month, quota levies were relieved for earthquake disasters in Langqiong and Dengchuan prefectures and counties, Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yunnan Langqiong and Dengchuan received earthquake tax relief.

sentences.zh: 六月丙寅，閩浙總督鍾祥以關防被竊褫職，以周天爵代之，以牛鑒為河南巡撫。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingyin: Min-Zhe governor-general Zhong Xiang was dismissed because his seal of office was stolen; Zhou Tianjue replaced him; Niu Jian was made governor of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingyin day, Zhong Xiang lost the Min-Zhe post over a stolen seal; Zhou Tianjue replaced him and Niu Jian took Henan.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，太子少保前兩江總督陶澍卒。

translations.literal: On day dinghai, former Liang-Jiang governor-general Tao Zhu, Grand Mentor of the Crown Prince, died.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day, Tao Zhu, former Liang-Jiang governor-general and grand mentor of the crown prince, died.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，調周天爵為湖廣總督。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Zhou Tianjue was transferred to be governor-general of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, Zhou Tianjue became Huguang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬子，命林則徐以禁販鴉片檄諭英吉利國及各國在粵洋商。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renzi: Lin Zexu was ordered to proclaim by edict to England and to merchants of all nations at Guangdong concerning the ban on opium trafficking.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month, on renzi day, Lin Zexu was ordered to notify England and Guangdong foreign merchants of the opium ban.

sentences.zh: 是月，給湖南華容縣水災口糧。

translations.literal: That month, famine rations were given for flood disaster in Huarong county, Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: That month flood victims in Hunan Huarong received famine rations.

sentences.zh: 八月庚午，經額布遷成都將軍，以托渾布為山東巡撫。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengwu: Jinge'ebu was transferred to be general at Chengdu; Tuohunbu was made governor of Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengwu day, Jinge'ebu became Chengdu general and Tuohunbu Shandong governor.

sentences.zh: 召烏-{里}-雅蘇台將軍保昌來京，以廉敬代之。

translations.literal: Uliasutai general Baochang was summoned to the capital; Lian Jing replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Baochang was recalled from Uliasutai and Lian Jing replaced him.

sentences.zh: 是月，給陝西葭州等三州縣被災口糧。

translations.literal: That month, famine rations were given to three prefectures and counties including Jiazhou, Shaanxi, stricken by disaster.
translations.idiomatic: That month disaster rations went to three Shaanxi districts including Jiazhou.

sentences.zh: 九月庚子，命托渾布查辦山東登州海賊，整頓水師。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengzi: Tuohunbu was ordered to investigate and handle sea bandits at Dengzhou, Shandong, and reorganize the navy.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengzi day, Tuohunbu was sent to suppress Dengzhou pirates and reform the navy.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，上閱健銳營兵。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, the Emperor reviewed the troops of the Jianrui Camp.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day, the Emperor reviewed Jianrui Camp troops.

sentences.zh: 己酉，哈豐阿遷廣州將軍，調棍楚克策楞為黑龍江將軍，德克金布為綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: On day jiyou, Hafeng'a was transferred to be general at Guangzhou; Kunchukecele was transferred to be general at Heilongjiang; Dekejinbu was made general at Suiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day, Hafeng'a went to Guangzhou, Kunchukecele to Heilongjiang, and Dekejinbu became Suiyuan general.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，山西巡撫申啟賢卒，賜恤如尚書例。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month: Shanxi governor Shen Qixian died; condolence gifts followed the precedent for a minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, Shanxi governor Shen Qixian died with ministerial mourning honors.

sentences.zh: 以楊國楨為山西巡撫。

translations.literal: Yang Guozhen was made governor of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Guozhen became Shanxi governor.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑安徽無為等十一州縣及屯坐各衛水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood relief was given for floods in eleven prefectures and counties of Anhui including Wuwei and garrison settlements of each guard.
translations.idiomatic: That month flood relief went to eleven Anhui districts including Wuwei and attached garrison settlements.

sentences.zh: 賑湖北黃梅等三縣災民。

translations.literal: Flood-stricken people in three counties of Hubei including Huangmei were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: Flood victims in three Hubei counties including Huangmei were relieved.

sentences.zh: 給湖北沔陽等九州縣，山東蒙陰縣，陝西府穀、神木二縣，湖南華容縣九州衛水災旱災口糧。

translations.literal: Famine rations were given for flood and drought disasters in nine prefectures and counties of Hubei including Mianyang, Mengyin county of Shandong, Fugu and Shenmu counties of Shaanxi, and nine prefectures and guards of Hunan including Huarong.
translations.idiomatic: Famine rations went to flood and drought districts in Hubei, Shandong Mengyin, Shaanxi Fugu and Shenmu, and nine Hunan prefectures and guards.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩安徽無為等三十二州縣、湖北沔陽等二十六州縣、河南睢州等二十一州縣、湖南澧州等九州縣衛水災新舊額賦。

translations.literal: New and old quota levies were remitted or deferred for flood disasters in thirty-two prefectures and counties of Anhui including Wuwei, twenty-six in Hubei including Mianyang, twenty-one in Henan including Suizhou, and nine prefectures and guards in Hunan including Lizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Flood tax relief covered thirty-two Anhui, twenty-six Hubei, twenty-one Henan, and nine Hunan districts.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚子，英船入廣東海港，林則徐督官軍擊走之，停其貿易。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengzi: English ships entered Guangdong harbor; Lin Zexu supervised government troops in driving them off and stopped their trade.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengzi day, English ships entered Guangdong; Lin Zexu drove them off and halted trade.

sentences.zh: 以程懋來為安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: Cheng Maolai was made governor of Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Maolai became Anhui governor.

sentences.zh: 戊申，德克金布遷廣州將軍，以松溥為綏遠城將軍，舒倫保為黑龍江將軍。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Dekejinbu was transferred to be general at Guangzhou; Songpo was made general at Suiyuan; Shulunbao was made general at Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Dekejinbu went to Guangzhou, Songpo to Suiyuan, and Shulunbao to Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，命濟克默特赴庫倫，迎哲布尊丹巴呼圖克圖來覲。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Jekemete was ordered to proceed to Kulun to meet and escort the Jebtsundamba Khutukhtu to audience.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Jekemete was sent to Kulun to escort the Jebtsundamba Khutukhtu to court.

sentences.zh: 是月，給江西德化等七縣、山西應州等四州縣災民口糧。

translations.literal: That month, famine rations were given to disaster victims in seven counties of Jiangxi including Dehua and four prefectures and counties of Shanxi including Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month disaster rations went to seven Jiangxi counties including Dehua and four Shanxi districts including Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 蠲免江西南昌等二十三縣、山西應州等八州縣、直隸安州等五州縣被災新舊額賦。

translations.literal: New and old quota levies on disaster areas were remitted in twenty-three counties of Jiangxi including Nanchang, eight prefectures and counties of Shanxi including Yingzhou, and five prefectures of Zhili including Anzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Disaster tax remissions covered twenty-three Jiangxi counties, eight Shanxi districts, and five Zhili prefectures.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，署兩江總督陳鑾卒，調鄧廷楨為兩江總督，林則徐為兩廣總督，裕謙為江蘇巡撫。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guihai: Acting Liang-Jiang governor-general Chen Juan died; Deng Tingzhen was transferred to be Liang-Jiang governor-general; Lin Zexu was made governor-general of Liang-Guang; Yu Qian was made governor of Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: On twelfth-month guihai day, Chen Juan died; Deng Tingzhen took Liang-Jiang, Lin Zexu Liang-Guang, and Yu Qian Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，哲布尊丹巴呼圖克圖等覲見。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, the Jebtsundamba Khutukhtu and others had audience.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day, the Jebtsundamba Khutukhtu and others were received in audience.

sentences.zh: 調伊-{里}-布為兩江總督，鄧廷楨為雲貴總督。

translations.literal: Yilibu was transferred to be Liang-Jiang governor-general; Deng Tingzhen was made Yun-Gui governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Yilibu became Liang-Jiang governor-general and Deng Tingzhen Yun-Gui governor-general.

sentences.zh: 癸未，命刑部尚書隆文在軍機大臣上行走。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Long Wen, Minister of Punishments, was ordered to serve on the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, Long Wen of the Ministry of Punishments joined the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 調鄧廷楨為閩浙總督，桂良為雲貴總督。

translations.literal: Deng Tingzhen was transferred to be Min-Zhe governor-general; Gui Liang was made Yun-Gui governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Tingzhen became Min-Zhe governor-general and Gui Liang Yun-Gui governor-general.

sentences.zh: 戊子，陳官俊免，以廖鴻荃為工部尚書。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Chen Guanjun was dismissed; Liao Hongquan was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, Chen Guanjun was dismissed and Liao Hongquan took the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 軍機大臣文慶免。

translations.literal: Grand Councilor Wen Qing was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Qing was dismissed from the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea and Ryukyu presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Korea and Ryukyu sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 二十年春正月壬辰朔，加王鼎太子太保。

translations.literal: Twentieth year, spring, first month, renchen new moon: Wang Ding was given the additional office of Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In year 20, on the first-month renchen new moon, Wang Ding received the additional title grand guardian of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以阿勒精阿為熱河都統。

translations.literal: On day wuxu, Alejing'a was made Rehe commander.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day, Alejing'a became Rehe commander.

sentences.zh: 己亥，理籓院禁哲布尊丹巴呼圖克圖用旗傘，並未奏明，奕紀褫御前大臣、戶部尚書、總管內務府大臣並紫韁，免管理籓院。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the Court of Colonial Affairs forbade the Jebtsundamba Khutukhtu from using banner umbrellas; moreover, without prior memorial, Yiji was stripped of imperial presence minister, Minister of Revenue, superintendent of the Imperial Household, and purple bridle, and dismissed from managing the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, the Court of Colonial Affairs barred the Khutukhtu's banner umbrellas; Yiji lost his court posts and purple bridle for acting without memorial.

sentences.zh: 賽尚阿降二品頂戴。

translations.literal: Saishang'a was demoted one rank in peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: Saishang'a lost one rank of peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 調隆文為戶部尚書。

translations.literal: Long Wen was transferred to be Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Long Wen became minister of revenue.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，皇后鈕祜祿氏崩。

translations.literal: On day renyin, the Empress Niohuru died.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day, Empress Niohuru died.

sentences.zh: 戊申，諡大行皇后為孝全皇后。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the late Empress was given the posthumous title Empress Xiaquan.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, the late empress was titled Empress Xiaquan.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，奕紀逮問。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Yiji was arrested for interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Yiji was arrested for investigation.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以奕紀收沙布朗餽送銀，遣戍黑龍江，賽尚阿等均下部嚴議。

translations.literal: On day gengshen, because Yiji had accepted silver gifts from the Shabron, he was sent into exile in Heilongjiang; Saishang'a and others were all referred to the Boards for severe deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day, Yiji was exiled to Heilongjiang for Shabron bribes; Saishang'a and others faced severe board review.

sentences.zh: 二月癸亥，以阿勒精阿為刑部尚書，訥爾經額為熱河都統，哈豐阿為西寧辦事大臣。

translations.literal: Second month, day guihai: Alejing'a was made Minister of Punishments; Ne'erjing'e was made Rehe commander; Hafeng'a was made commissioner at Xining.
translations.idiomatic: On second-month guihai day, Alejing'a took punishments, Ne'erjing'e Rehe, and Hafeng'a Xining.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，戶部尚書何淩漢卒，以卓秉恬代之。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Minister of Revenue He Linghan died; Zhuo Bingtian replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day, He Linghan died and Zhuo Bingtian took revenue.

sentences.zh: 以祁俊空話藻為兵部尚書，沈岐為左都御史。

translations.literal: Qi Junzao was made Minister of War; Shen Qi was made Left Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Junzao became minister of war and Shen Qi left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，河東河道總督栗毓美卒，以文沖為河東河道總督。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Grand Canal-East transport governor Li Yumei died; Wen Chong replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Li Yumei died and Wen Chong became canal-east transport governor.

sentences.zh: 是月，給安徽桐城縣貧民口糧。

translations.literal: That month, famine rations were given to poor people of Tongcheng county, Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: That month poor people in Anhui Tongcheng received famine rations.

sentences.zh: 貸山西河保等營兵丁穀石。

translations.literal: Stored grain was loaned to soldiers of camps including Hebao, Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi camps including Hebao received loaned grain.

sentences.zh: 三月，命何汝霖在軍機大臣上學習行走。

translations.literal: Third month: He Rulei was ordered to study while serving on the Grand Council.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, He Rulei was ordered to study on the Grand Council.

sentences.zh: 召奕山來京，以布彥泰為伊犁將軍。

translations.literal: Yi Shan was summoned to the capital; Buyantai was made Ili general.
translations.idiomatic: Yi Shan was recalled and Buyantai became Ili general.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以壁昌為察哈爾都統。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Bichang was made Chahar commander.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day, Bichang became Chahar commander.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸山西吉州等九州廳縣倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, stored grain was loaned to nine prefectures and departments of Shanxi including Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month nine Shanxi prefectures and departments including Jizhou received loaned grain.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛酉朔，冊諡孝全皇后，翼日頒詔。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, xinyou new moon: posthumous title was conferred on Empress Xiaquan; the day after, an edict was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month, on the xinyou new moon, Empress Xiaquan was given posthumous honors and an edict followed next day.

sentences.zh: 己巳，調經額布為吉林將軍。

translations.literal: On day jisi, Jinge'ebu was transferred to be general at Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day, Jinge'ebu became Jilin general.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以祥康為庫倫辦事大臣。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Xiang Kang was made commissioner at Kulun.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, Xiang Kang became Kulun commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，上詣黑龍潭祈雨。

translations.literal: On day wuyin, the Emperor went to Black Dragon Pool to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day, the Emperor prayed for rain at Black Dragon Pool.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，賜李承霖等一百八十人進士及第出身有差。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Li Chenglin and one hundred eighty others were granted jinshi and other degrees with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Li Chenglin and 180 others received jinshi degrees in varying ranks.

sentences.zh: 戊子，上詣廣潤祠祈雨。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, the Emperor went to Guangrun Shrine to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day, the Emperor prayed for rain at Guangrun Shrine.

sentences.zh: 是月，貸直隸紫金關及所屬浮圖峪等三營弁兵倉穀。

translations.literal: That month, stored grain was loaned to troops of Zijinguan and three camps under it including Futuyu, Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhili troops at Zijinguan and three subordinate camps received loaned grain.

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯，以色克津阿為綏遠城將軍。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingmao: Sekejin'a was made general at Suiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingmao day, Sekejin'a became Suiyuan general.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，林則徐等奏擊毀載煙洋艇。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, Lin Zexu and others memorialized that opium-carrying foreign boats had been destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, Lin Zexu reported destruction of opium boats.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，英船入浙洋，圍定海縣城。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, English ships entered Zhejiang waters and besieged Dinghai county seat.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, English ships entered Zhejiang and besieged Dinghai.

sentences.zh: 命余步雲會烏爾恭額等援之。

translations.literal: Yu Buyun was ordered to join Wu'ergong'e and others in relief.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Buyun was ordered to reinforce Wu'ergong'e at Dinghai.

sentences.zh: 甲申，英人陷定海縣，知縣姚懷祥等死之。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, the English took Dinghai county; Magistrate Yao Huaixiang and others died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day, the English captured Dinghai; Magistrate Yao Huaixiang and others were killed.

sentences.zh: 褫烏爾恭額及浙江提督祝廷彪職，仍留任。

translations.literal: Wu'ergong'e and Zhejiang provincial commander Zhu Tingbiao were stripped of office but retained in post.
translations.idiomatic: Wu'ergong'e and Zhejiang commander Zhu Tingbiao were demoted yet kept in place.

sentences.zh: 調瑚松額為熱河都統，訥爾經額為陝甘總督。

translations.literal: Husong'e was transferred to be Rehe commander; Ne'erjing'e was made Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Husong'e became Rehe commander and Ne'erjing'e Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸巳，英船犯浙江乍浦海口。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guisi: English ships attacked Zhejiang Zhaopu harbor.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month, on guisi day, English ships attacked Zhaopu in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 命奇明保率兵禦之。

translations.literal: Qi Mingbao was ordered to lead troops in defense.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Mingbao was ordered to lead troops against them.

sentences.zh: 英師犯福建廈門砲臺，參將陳勝元等擊卻之。

translations.literal: The English fleet attacked Fujian Xiamen batteries; Vice Commander Chen Shengyuan and others drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: English forces attacked Xiamen batteries; Chen Shengyuan and others repulsed them.

sentences.zh: 丙申，褫浙江巡撫烏爾恭額職，以劉韻珂代之。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, Zhejiang governor Wu'ergong'e was stripped of office; Liu Yunke replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day, Wu'ergong'e lost the Zhejiang governorship and Liu Yunke replaced him.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，命伊-{里}-布為欽差大臣，赴浙江剿辦。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Yilibu was made Imperial Commissioner to proceed to Zhejiang to suppress and handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day, Yilibu became imperial commissioner for Zhejiang operations.

sentences.zh: 以裕謙兼署兩江總督。

translations.literal: Yu Qian was ordered to act additionally as Liang-Jiang governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Qian was ordered to act as Liang-Jiang governor-general as well.

sentences.zh: 以湍多布為伊犁參贊大臣，花山太為塔爾巴哈台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Tuanduobu was made Ili councilor; Huashantai was made councilor at Tarbagatai.
translations.idiomatic: Tuanduobu became Ili councilor and Huashantai Tarbagatai councilor.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，英船泊天津口外，遞信與琦善訴屈。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, English ships anchored outside Tianjin; they delivered a letter to Qishan stating grievances.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day, English ships lay off Tianjin and sent Qishan a letter of grievance.

sentences.zh: 命琦善接收，仍飭勿進口。

translations.literal: Qishan was ordered to receive it and still charged them not to enter port.
translations.idiomatic: Qishan was ordered to accept the letter but still forbid entry into port.

sentences.zh: 丙午，花山太遷喀什噶爾辦事領隊大臣，調湍多布為塔爾巴哈台參贊大臣，以福興阿為伊犁參贊大臣。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Huashantai was transferred to be leading commander at Kashgar; Tuanduobu was transferred to be councilor at Tarbagatai; Fuxing'a was made Ili councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day, Huashantai went to Kashgar, Tuanduobu to Tarbagatai, and Fuxing'a became Ili councilor.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，林則徐等奏續獲販煙人犯。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Lin Zexu and others memorialized further captures of opium traffickers.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day, Lin Zexu reported more opium arrests.

sentences.zh: 諭以空言搪塞，切責之。

translations.literal: An edict rebuked them for stalling with empty words.
translations.idiomatic: The court rebuked them for empty excuses.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，英船至山海關等處。

translations.literal: On day yimao, English ships reached Shanhaiguan and other places.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day, English ships reached Shanhaiguan and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，命伊-{里}-布等，英人如有投遞書信，即接受馳奏。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Yilibu and others were ordered: if English presented letters, to accept and memorialize urgently.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day, Yilibu and others were told to accept any English letters and memorialize at once.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑湖北沔陽等三州縣水災。

translations.literal: That month, flood relief was given for floods in three prefectures and counties of Hubei including Mianyang.
translations.idiomatic: That month flood relief went to three Hubei districts including Mianyang.

sentences.zh: 八月甲子，以邵甲名署浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiazi: Shao Jiaming was ordered to act as governor of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiazi day, Shao Jiaming acted as Zhejiang governor.

sentences.zh: 丙子，英人復侵福建廈門，提督陳階平等擊走之。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, the English again attacked Fujian Xiamen; Regional Commander Chen Jieping and others drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day, the English attacked Xiamen again; Chen Jieping and others drove them off.

sentences.zh: 己卯，命琦善為欽差大臣，赴廣東查辦，並諭伊-{里}-布及沿海督撫防守耍隘，洋船停泊外洋勿問。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Qishan was made Imperial Commissioner to proceed to Guangdong to investigate and handle affairs; Yilibu and coastal governors-general and governors were also instructed to defend strategic passes and not to interfere with foreign ships anchored in outer seas.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Qishan was sent to Guangdong as imperial commissioner; coastal officials were told to hold the passes and leave outer-harbor ships alone.

sentences.zh: 調訥爾經額署直隸總督，以瑚松額署陝甘總督。

translations.literal: Ne'erjing'e was transferred to act as Zhili governor-general; Husong'e was ordered to act as Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Ne'erjing'e acted as Zhili governor-general and Husong'e as Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，廉敬遷成都將軍，以德楞額為烏-{里}-雅蘇台將軍。

translations.literal: On day gengchen, Lian Jing was transferred to be general at Chengdu; Deleng'e was made Uliasutai general.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day, Lian Jing became Chengdu general and Deleng'e Uliasutai general.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，裕謙奏英人呈遞原書，不敢上聞。

translations.literal: On day xinsi, Yu Qian memorialized that the English had presented their original letter but he dared not report it to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day, Yu Qian admitted he had withheld the English original letter.

sentences.zh: 諭切責之。

translations.literal: An edict severely rebuked him.
translations.idiomatic: The court severely rebuked him.

sentences.zh: 是月，給江蘇上元等十四縣水災口糧並修屋費。

translations.literal: That month, famine rations and funds for repairing houses were given for flood disaster in fourteen counties of Jiangsu including Shangyuan.
translations.idiomatic: That month fourteen Jiangsu counties including Shangyuan received flood rations and house-repair funds.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅，林則徐、鄧廷楨命交部嚴加議處。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengyin: Lin Zexu and Deng Tingzhen were ordered referred to the Boards for severe deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengyin day, Lin Zexu and Deng Tingzhen faced severe board review.

sentences.zh: 以琦善署兩廣總督。

translations.literal: Qishan was ordered to act as governor-general of Liang-Guang.
translations.idiomatic: Qishan was ordered to act as Liang-Guang governor-general.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以托渾布奏英船南去，命耆英、托渾布酌撤防兵。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, because Tuohunbu memorialized that English ships had sailed south, Qishan and Tuohunbu were ordered to consider withdrawing defensive troops.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day, after Tuohunbu reported English ships had gone south, Qishan and Tuohunbu were told to consider reducing defenses.

sentences.zh: 召鄧廷楨來京，以顏伯燾為閩浙總督，張澧中為雲南巡撫。

translations.literal: Deng Tingzhen was summoned to the capital; Yan Bozhen was made Min-Zhe governor-general; Zhang Lizhong was made governor of Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Deng Tingzhen was recalled; Yan Bozhen took Min-Zhe and Zhang Lizhong Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 甲午，諭周天爵等恤湖北各州縣水災。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, an edict ordered Zhou Tianjue and others to relieve flood disasters in various prefectures and counties of Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, Zhou Tianjue and others were ordered to relieve Hubei flood disasters.

sentences.zh: 乙未，褫林則徐、鄧廷楨職，命赴廣東候查問。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Lin Zexu and Deng Tingzhen were stripped of office and ordered to proceed to Guangdong to await interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Lin Zexu and Deng Tingzhen lost office and were sent to Guangdong for inquiry.

sentences.zh: 己亥，英船入浙江慈谿、餘姚二縣內洋，伊-{里}-布等擊走之。

translations.literal: On day jihai, English ships entered the inner sea off Cixi and Yuyao counties, Zhejiang; Yilibu and others drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, English ships entered inner waters off Cixi and Yuyao; Yilibu and others drove them away.

sentences.zh: 以烏爾恭額不代奏英人書信，逮問。

translations.literal: Because Uergen'e had not forwarded the British letter to the throne, he was arrested for trial.
translations.idiomatic: Uergen'e was arrested for failing to forward the British letter.

sentences.zh: 是月，給江蘇泰興縣水災口糧。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain was issued to Taixing county, Jiangsu, for flood disaster.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Taixing in Jiangsu received flood rations.

sentences.zh: 十月壬申，以謁陵命莊親王等留京辦事。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day renshen: because the Emperor would visit the tombs, the Prince of Zhuang and others were left in the capital to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In month 10, renshen, the Prince of Zhuang and others stayed in Beijing for the tomb visit.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以孝全皇后梓宮奉安龍泉峪，上詣觀德殿行祖奠禮。

translations.literal: On day renwu, as Empress Xiaoquan's coffin was placed at Longquan Valley, the Emperor went to Guande Hall to perform the ancestral offering rite.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, Empress Xiaoquan's coffin went to Longquan Valley and the Emperor offered at Guande Hall.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，調祿普為烏-{里}-雅蘇台將軍。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Lupu was transferred to be Uliasutai general.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, Lupu became Uliasutai general.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑直隸滄州等三州縣災民。

translations.literal: That month, disaster victims in three Zhili prefectures and counties including Cangzhou were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Cangzhou and two other Zhili districts received disaster relief.

sentences.zh: 給安徽東流、含山二縣軍民口糧。

translations.literal: Ration grain was issued to military and civil people in Dongliu and Hanshan counties, Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: Dongliu and Hanshan in Anhui received military and civil rations.

sentences.zh: 貸奉天白旗堡、小黑山水災口糧。

translations.literal: Ration grain was loaned for flood disaster at Baiqibao and Xiaoheishan in Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: Flood rations were loaned at Fengtian's Baiqibao and Xiaoheishan.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩直隸滄州等三十三州縣、湖北沔陽等八州縣衛水災新舊正雜額賦。

translations.literal: Principal and miscellaneous quota levies, old and new, were remitted or deferred for flood disaster in thirty-three Zhili prefectures and counties including Cangzhou and eight Hubei prefectures, counties, and guards including Mianyang.
translations.idiomatic: Flood quotas were remitted or deferred for thirty-three Zhili districts including Cangzhou and eight Hubei districts including Mianyang.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚寅，上謁西陵，免經過地方額賦十分之五。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengyin: the Emperor visited the Western Tombs and remitted five-tenths of quota levies on places the route passed through.
translations.idiomatic: In month 11, gengyin, the Emperor visited the Western Tombs with half route-tax relief.

sentences.zh: 甲午，上謁泰陵、泰東陵、昌陵，並詣孝穆皇后、孝慎皇后陵寢奠酒，孝全皇后梓宮前行遷奠禮。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, the Emperor visited Tailing, Taidongling, and Changling, also went to the tomb palaces of Empresses Xiaomu and Xiaoshen to offer libation, and performed the transfer offering rite before Empress Xiaoquan's coffin.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, the Emperor visited Tailing, Taidongling, and Changling, offered at Empresses Xiaomu and Xiaoshen's tombs, and performed the transfer rite for Empress Xiaoquan.

sentences.zh: 乙未，孝全皇后梓宮奉安地宮，上臨視，命皇子行禮。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Empress Xiaoquan's coffin was interred in the underground palace; the Emperor oversaw in person and ordered the prince to perform the rites.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, Empress Xiaoquan was buried in the underground palace while the Emperor watched and had a prince perform the rites.

sentences.zh: 己亥，上還京師。

translations.literal: On day jihai, the Emperor returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, the Emperor returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，祿普改荊州將軍，調奕湘為烏-{里}-雅蘇台將軍。

translations.literal: On day guimao, Lupu was made Jingzhou general and Yixiang was transferred to be Uliasutai general.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day, Lupu took Jingzhou and Yixiang Uliasutai.

sentences.zh: 英人陷定海。

translations.literal: The British took Dinghai.
translations.idiomatic: The British captured Dinghai.

sentences.zh: 戊申，烏爾恭額論絞。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Uergen'e was sentenced to strangulation.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day, Uergen'e was sentenced to strangulation.

sentences.zh: 壬子，伊-{里}-布奏英人要求澳門、定海貿易。

translations.literal: On day renzi, Yilibu memorialized that the British demanded trade at Macao and Dinghai.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day, Yilibu reported British demands to trade at Macao and Dinghai.

sentences.zh: 諭琦善令英人退還定海。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Qishan to make the British withdraw from Dinghai.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Qishan to get the British out of Dinghai.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以周天爵擅用非刑，褫職，遣戍伊犁。

translations.literal: On day guichou, because Zhou Tianjue had improperly applied corporal punishment, he was stripped of office and exiled to Yili.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day, Zhou Tianjue lost his post and was exiled to Yili for improper corporal punishment.

sentences.zh: 以裕泰為湖廣總督，以吳其濬為湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: Yutai was made Huguang governor-general and Wu Qijun Hunan governor.
translations.idiomatic: Yutai became Huguang governor-general and Wu Qijun Hunan governor.

sentences.zh: 是月，賑江蘇上元等十六縣、直隸天津縣水旱災。

translations.literal: That month, flood and drought disasters were relieved in sixteen Jiangsu counties including Shangyuan and Tianjin county, Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: That month, sixteen Jiangsu counties including Shangyuan and Tianjin in Zhili received flood-and-drought relief.

sentences.zh: 貸江蘇江寧駐防及督協各營駐紮災區兵餉、黑龍江墨爾根城水災屯丁口糧屋費。

translations.literal: Military pay was loaned to the Jiangning garrison in Jiangsu and troops of each provincial and cooperative camp stationed in disaster areas, and ration grain, housing expenses, and other supplies were loaned to flooded colonist households at Mo'ergen city, Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangning garrison and provincial-cooperative disaster troops received pay loans, and Heilongjiang's Mo'ergen colonists received flood rations and housing funds.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩江蘇泰州等七十二州縣衛、直隸天津縣、山西河曲縣新舊額賦。

translations.literal: Old and new quota levies were remitted or deferred for seventy-two Jiangsu prefectures, counties, guards, and banners including Taizhou, Tianjin county, Zhili, and Hequ county, Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Taizhou and seventy-one other Jiangsu units, Tianjin, and Shanxi's Hequ had quotas remitted or deferred.

sentences.zh: 十二月，以孝全皇后陞祔奉先殿，上親詣告祭。

translations.literal: Twelfth month: as Empress Xiaoquan was elevated for joint worship at the Imperial Ancestral Hall, the Emperor personally went to announce sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In month 12, Empress Xiaoquan entered the Imperial Ancestral Hall and the Emperor announced the offering in person.

sentences.zh: 翼日，命皇四子行禮。

translations.literal: The next day, the fourth prince was ordered to perform the rites.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the fourth prince performed the rites by order.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，調-{余}-步雲為浙江提督。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Yu Buyun was transferred to be Zhejiang provincial military commander.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, Yu Buyun became Zhejiang military commander.

sentences.zh: 以鐵麟為察哈爾都統，恩桂為左都御史。

translations.literal: Tielin was made Chahar commandant and Engui left censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Tielin became Chahar commandant and Engui left censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 以壁昌為伊犁參贊大臣。

translations.literal: Bichang was made Ili assistant commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Bichang became Ili assistant commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己卯，調吳文鎔為湖北巡撫，以劉鴻翱為福建巡撫。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Wu Wenrong was transferred to be Hubei governor and Liu Hong'ao was made Fujian governor.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, Wu Wenrong took Hubei and Liu Hong'ao Fujian.

sentences.zh: 癸未，召瑚松額來京，以恩特亨額署陝甘總督。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, Husong'e was summoned to the capital and Enteheng'e acted Shaanxi-Gansu governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day, Husong'e was recalled to Beijing and Enteheng'e acted at Shaanxi-Gansu.

sentences.zh: 是月，給福建龍谿、南靖二縣水災口糧屋費。

translations.literal: That month, ration grain and housing repair funds were issued for flood disaster in Longxi and Nanjing counties, Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Longxi and Nanjing in Fujian received flood rations and housing funds.

sentences.zh: 貸江蘇江陰等三營兵餉。

translations.literal: Military pay was loaned to three Jiangsu camps including Jiangyin.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangyin and two other Jiangsu camps received pay loans.

sentences.zh: 蠲緩浙江長興等四縣水旱災新舊正雜額賦。

translations.literal: Principal and miscellaneous quota levies, old and new, were remitted or deferred for flood and drought disaster in four Zhejiang counties including Changxing.
translations.idiomatic: Changxing and three other Zhejiang counties had flood-and-drought quotas remitted or deferred.

sentences.zh: 是歲，朝鮮入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Korea presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Korea sent tribute.
